@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/installer/project_files.go","mode":420,"size":8192,"sha256":"2dba011d9b6cc9bd7e91df4bad89dca6978af7cb0572d7d3939d5ad3679d319a","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":8192}
package installer

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

const (
	desiredDocument   = "inventory/group_vars/all/platform-installer.yml"
	generatedDocument = "inventory/group_vars/all/platform-state.yml"
)

type projectDocument struct {
	LogicalPath string
	Digest      string
}

func digestBytes(content []byte) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256(content)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func cleanRoot(root string) (string, error) {
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
	if err := assertSafeExistingAncestors(absolute); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(absolute)
	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() || pathEntryUnsafe(info) {
		return "", blocked("PROJECT_PATH_INVALID", "Project root is not a directory", "projectRoot")
	}
	return absolute, nil
}

func assertSafeExistingAncestors(path string) error {
	for current := filepath.Clean(path); ; current = filepath.Dir(current) {
		info, err := os.Lstat(current)
		if err != nil {
			return blocked("PROJECT_PATH_INVALID", "Project path cannot be inspected", "projectRoot")
		}
		if pathEntryUnsafe(info) {
			return blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Project path contains a symlink or reparse point", "projectRoot")
		}
		parent := filepath.Dir(current)
		if parent == current {
			return nil
		}
	}
}

func logicalPath(path string) string { return filepath.ToSlash(path) }

func safeProjectPath(root, logical string, allowMissing bool) (string, error) {
	if logical == "" || filepath.IsAbs(logical) || filepath.VolumeName(logical) != "" {
		return "", blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Managed document path is unsafe", "document.logicalPath")
	}
	clean := filepath.Clean(filepath.FromSlash(logical))
	if clean == "." || clean == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(clean, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
		return "", blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Managed document path escapes the project", "document.logicalPath")
	}
	path := filepath.Join(root, clean)
	relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, path)
	if err != nil || relative == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
		return "", blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Managed document path escapes the project", "document.logicalPath")
	}
	current := root
	parts := strings.Split(filepath.ToSlash(clean), "/")
	for index, part := range parts {
		current = filepath.Join(current, part)
		info, statErr := os.Lstat(current)
		if statErr != nil {
			if os.IsNotExist(statErr) && allowMissing {
				break
			}
			return "", blocked("WRITE_OWNERSHIP_REQUIRED", "Installer-owned document does not exist", "document")
		}
		if pathEntryUnsafe(info) {
			return "", blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Managed document path contains a symlink or reparse point", "document.logicalPath")
		}
		if index < len(parts)-1 && !info.IsDir() {
			return "", blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Managed document parent is not a directory", "document.logicalPath")
		}
	}
	return path, nil
}

func collectProjectDocuments(root string) ([]projectDocument, string, error) {
	candidates := []string{"project.yml", "ansible.cfg", "inventory/hosts.yml"}
	packageDocuments, err := applicationPackageDocuments(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	packageContents := map[string][]byte{}
	for _, record := range packageDocuments {
		candidates = append(candidates, record.LogicalPath)
		packageContents[record.LogicalPath] = record.content
	}
	for _, directory := range []string{"inventory/group_vars", "inventory/host_vars"} {
		base := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(directory))
		if _, err := os.Stat(base); os.IsNotExist(err) {
			continue
		}
		err := filepath.WalkDir(base, func(path string, entry os.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
			if walkErr != nil {
				return walkErr
			}
			if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
				return blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Canonical project documents must not contain symlinks", "project")
			}
			if entry.IsDir() {
				return nil
			}
			extension := strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(entry.Name()))
			if extension != ".yml" && extension != ".yaml" && extension != ".json" {
				return nil
			}
			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, path)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			candidates = append(candidates, logicalPath(relative))
			return nil
		})
		if err != nil {
			return nil, "", err
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(candidates)
	seen := make(map[string]bool)
	documents := make([]projectDocument, 0, len(candidates))
	var revisionInput []byte
	for _, logical := range candidates {
		if seen[logical] {
			continue
		}
		seen[logical] = true
		path, err := safeProjectPath(root, logical, true)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, "", err
		}
		content, packageFile := packageContents[logical]
		if !packageFile {
			content, err = os.ReadFile(path)
		} else {
			err = nil
		}
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, "", err
		}
		digest := digestBytes(content)
		documents = append(documents, projectDocument{LogicalPath: logical, Digest: digest})
		if logical != generatedDocument {
			revisionInput = append(revisionInput, []byte(logical)...)
			revisionInput = append(revisionInput, 0)
			revisionInput = append(revisionInput, []byte(digest)...)
			revisionInput = append(revisionInput, 0)
		}
	}
	return documents, digestBytes(revisionInput), nil
}

// ProjectRevision returns the canonical raw-byte revision used to bind an edit
// session. It does not parse or mutate project content.
func ProjectRevision(root string) (string, error) {
	clean, err := cleanRoot(root)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	_, revision, err := collectProjectDocuments(clean)
	return revision, err
}

func managedHostDocument(hostID string) string {
	return "inventory/host_vars/" + hostID + "/platform-installer.yml"
}

func discoverOwnedPaths(root string) ([]string, error) {
	paths := []string{"ansible.cfg", "inventory/hosts.yml", desiredDocument}
	hostRoot := filepath.Join(root, "inventory", "host_vars")
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(hostRoot)
	if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() {
			paths = append(paths, managedHostDocument(entry.Name()))
		}
	}
	owned := make([]string, 0, len(paths))
	for _, logical := range paths {
		path, err := safeProjectPath(root, logical, true)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		content, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		ownedHeader := managedHeader
		if logical == "ansible.cfg" {
			ownedHeader = managedConfigHeader
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(string(content), string(ownedHeader)) {
			owned = append(owned, logical)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(owned)
	return owned, nil
}

func copyProject(source string) (string, func(), error) {
	parent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "platform-installer-stage-")
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, err
	}
	cleanup := func() { _ = os.RemoveAll(parent) }
	destination := filepath.Join(parent, "project")
	err = filepath.WalkDir(source, func(path string, entry os.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
		if walkErr != nil {
			return walkErr
		}
		relative, err := filepath.Rel(source, path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if relative == "secrets" {
			if entry.IsDir() {
				return filepath.SkipDir
			}
			return nil
		}
		if relative == ".git" || relative == ".runtime" {
			return filepath.SkipDir
		}
		info, infoErr := entry.Info()
		if infoErr != nil {
			return infoErr
		}
		if pathEntryUnsafe(info) {
			return blocked("PATH_UNSAFE", "Staged projects must not contain symlinks", "project")
		}
		target := filepath.Join(destination, relative)
		if entry.IsDir() {
			return os.MkdirAll(target, 0o755)
		}
		input, err := os.Open(path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		defer input.Close()
		output, err := os.OpenFile(target, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, info.Mode().Perm())
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, copyErr := io.Copy(output, input)
		closeErr := output.Close()
		if copyErr != nil {
			return copyErr
		}
		return closeErr
	})
	if err != nil {
		cleanup()
		return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("stage project: %w", err)
	}
	return destination, cleanup, nil
}

func syncDirectory(path string) error {
	directory, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {

package installer

import (
	"os"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"
)

type replaceFunc func(source, destination string) error

var moveFileEx = syscall.NewLazyDLL("kernel32.dll").NewProc("MoveFileExW")

const moveFileReplaceExisting = 0x1
const moveFileWriteThrough = 0x8

func atomicReplace(source, destination string) error {
	from, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	to, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(destination)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result, _, callErr := moveFileEx.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(from)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(to)),
		moveFileReplaceExisting|moveFileWriteThrough)
	if result == 0 {
		if callErr != nil && callErr != syscall.Errno(0) {
			return callErr
		}
		return os.ErrInvalid
	}
	return nil
}

func syncDirectory(path string) error { return nil }

@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/installer/secret_output_files.go","mode":420,"size":13679,"sha256":"52420f3407b06331a06f0df8a2a0cbd4778b485cfeb7e60bc00a48dcf5196768","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":13679}
package installer

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
)

var (
	secretOutputProjectID    = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,127}$`)
	secretOutputDeploymentID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$`)
	secretOutputPackageID    = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{32}$`)
	secretOutputRunID        = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$`)
	secretOutputDigest       = regexp.MustCompile(`^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)
)

var ErrSecretOutputFiles = errors.New("SECRET_OUTPUT_FILES_UNAVAILABLE")

type SecretOutputStagingRetainedError struct{ Path string }

func (*SecretOutputStagingRetainedError) Error() string { return "EXPORT_STAGING_RETAINED" }

type SecretOutputFileReceipt struct {
	ReceiptID     string            `json:"receiptId"`
	Directory     string            `json:"directory"`
	Digests       map[string]string `json:"ciphertextDigests"`
	ProjectID     string            `json:"projectId"`
	DeploymentID  string            `json:"deploymentId"`
	PackageID     string            `json:"packageId"`
	SourceRunID   string            `json:"sourceRunId"`
	Generation    int               `json:"generation"`
	RuntimeDigest string            `json:"runtimeDigest"`
}

type secretOutputLocalReceipt struct {
	SchemaVersion int               `json:"schemaVersion"`
	ProjectID     string            `json:"projectId"`
	DeploymentID  string            `json:"deploymentId"`
	PackageID     string            `json:"packageId"`
	SourceRunID   string            `json:"sourceRunId"`
	Generation    int               `json:"generation"`
	RuntimeDigest string            `json:"runtimeDigest"`
	ReceiptID     string            `json:"receiptId"`
	Entries       []string          `json:"entries"`
	Digests       map[string]string `json:"ciphertextDigests"`
}

// PublishSecretOutputFiles writes only the two encrypted, fixed-name output
// entries and their completion receipt. It uses the existing platform-safe
// directory-handle writer, never overwrites a package, and publishes by one
// no-replace directory rename. On failure it does not guess that pathname
// cleanup is identity-safe.
func PublishSecretOutputFiles(parent, projectID, deploymentID, packageID, sourceRunID string, generation int, runtimeDigest string, adminTokenAge, unsealSharesAge []byte) (SecretOutputFileReceipt, error) {
	return publishSecretOutputFiles(parent, projectID, deploymentID, packageID, sourceRunID, generation, runtimeDigest, adminTokenAge, unsealSharesAge, nil)
}

// Fault injection stays local to this publication operation; production has
// no global hooks or alternate writer.
func publishSecretOutputFiles(parent, projectID, deploymentID, packageID, sourceRunID string, generation int, runtimeDigest string, adminTokenAge, unsealSharesAge []byte, before func(string) error) (SecretOutputFileReceipt, error) {
	check := func(stage string) error {
		if before != nil {
			return before(stage)
		}
		return nil
	}
	if parent == "" || !secretOutputProjectID.MatchString(projectID) || !secretOutputDeploymentID.MatchString(deploymentID) || !secretOutputPackageID.MatchString(packageID) || !secretOutputRunID.MatchString(sourceRunID) || generation < 1 || !secretOutputDigest.MatchString(runtimeDigest) || len(adminTokenAge) == 0 || len(adminTokenAge) > 131072 || len(unsealSharesAge) == 0 || len(unsealSharesAge) > 131072 {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	var random [16]byte
	if _, err := rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	receiptID := hex.EncodeToString(random[:])
	digests := map[string]string{"admin-token": ciphertextDigest(adminTokenAge), "unseal-shares": ciphertextDigest(unsealSharesAge)}
	name := packageID
	receipt := secretOutputLocalReceipt{SchemaVersion: 1, ProjectID: projectID, DeploymentID: deploymentID, PackageID: packageID, SourceRunID: sourceRunID, Generation: generation, RuntimeDigest: runtimeDigest, ReceiptID: receiptID, Entries: []string{"admin-token", "unseal-shares"}, Digests: digests}
	encodedReceipt, err := json.Marshal(receipt)
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	root, err := openExportDestinationDirectory(parent)
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer root.close()
	projectRoot := root
	secrets, err := root.createDirectory("secrets")
	if err != nil {
		secrets, err = openSecretOutputDirectory(root, []string{"secrets"})
	}
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer secrets.close()
	if check("project-flush") != nil || syncSecretOutputDirectory(projectRoot) != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	deployment, err := secrets.createDirectory(deploymentID)
	if err != nil {
		deployment, err = openSecretOutputDirectory(secrets, []string{deploymentID})
	}
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer deployment.close()
	if syncSecretOutputDirectory(secrets) != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	root = deployment
	parent = filepath.Join(parent, "secrets", deploymentID)
	staging, stagingName, err := root.createStaging(name)
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer staging.close()
	retained := func() error {
		path := filepath.Join(parent, stagingName)
		if len(path) > 4096 {
			path = ""
		}
		return &SecretOutputStagingRetainedError{Path: path}
	}
	entries := []struct {
		name string
		data []byte
	}{{"admin-token.age", adminTokenAge}, {"unseal-shares.age", unsealSharesAge}}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if err := staging.writeFile(entry.name, entry.data); err != nil {
			return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, retained()
		}
		readBack, _, err := staging.readFile([]string{entry.name}, 131072)
		if err != nil || len(readBack) != len(entry.data) || ciphertextDigest(readBack) != ciphertextDigest(entry.data) {
			return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, retained()
		}
	}
	if err := staging.writeFile("complete", encodedReceipt); err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, retained()
	}
	readBack, _, err := staging.readFile([]string{"complete"}, 8192)
	if err != nil || string(readBack) != string(encodedReceipt) {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, retained()
	}
	if check("staging-flush") != nil || syncSecretOutputDirectory(staging) != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, retained()
	}
	if check("publish") != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, retained()
	}
	if err := root.publish(staging, stagingName, name); err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, retained()
	}
	if check("published-flush") != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	published, err := root.openDirectory([]string{name})
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer published.close()
	if published.identity() != staging.identity() || syncSecretOutputDirectory(staging) != nil || syncSecretOutputDirectory(root) != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	for _, entry := range append(entries, struct {
		name string
		data []byte
	}{"complete", encodedReceipt}) {
		data, _, readErr := published.readFile([]string{entry.name}, 131072)
		if readErr != nil || !bytes.Equal(data, entry.data) {
			return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
		}
	}
	if check("binding-readback") != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	currentRoot, err := openExportDestinationDirectory(filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(parent)))
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer currentRoot.close()
	currentSecrets, err := currentRoot.openDirectory([]string{"secrets"})
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer currentSecrets.close()
	currentDeployment, err := currentSecrets.openDirectory([]string{deploymentID})
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer currentDeployment.close()
	if currentRoot.identity() != projectRoot.identity() || currentSecrets.identity() != secrets.identity() || currentDeployment.identity() != root.identity() {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	return SecretOutputFileReceipt{ReceiptID: receiptID, Directory: filepath.Join(parent, name), Digests: digests, ProjectID: projectID, DeploymentID: deploymentID, PackageID: packageID, SourceRunID: sourceRunID, Generation: generation, RuntimeDigest: runtimeDigest}, nil
}

// ReadSecretOutputFiles verifies a previously published package through the
// same safe opened-directory primitives. It returns only encrypted bytes and
// never follows a substituted package/file path.
func ReadSecretOutputFiles(parent, projectID, deploymentID, packageID, sourceRunID string, generation int, runtimeDigest string) (SecretOutputFileReceipt, map[string][]byte, error) {
	if parent == "" || !secretOutputProjectID.MatchString(projectID) || !secretOutputDeploymentID.MatchString(deploymentID) || !secretOutputPackageID.MatchString(packageID) || !secretOutputRunID.MatchString(sourceRunID) || generation < 1 || !secretOutputDigest.MatchString(runtimeDigest) {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	root, err := openExportDestinationDirectory(parent)
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer root.close()
	name := packageID
	projectRoot := root
	secrets, err := openSecretOutputDirectory(root, []string{"secrets"})
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer secrets.close()
	root = secrets
	parent = filepath.Join(parent, "secrets")
	deployment, err := openSecretOutputDirectory(root, []string{deploymentID})
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer deployment.close()
	directory, err := openSecretOutputDirectory(deployment, []string{name})
	if err != nil {
		if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
			return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
		}
		// Files published before package-specific directories remain readable
		// only when their complete receipt matches the requested package.
		directory = deployment
		name = ""
	} else {
		defer directory.close()
	}
	encoded, _, err := directory.readFile([]string{"complete"}, 8192)
	var receipt secretOutputLocalReceipt
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(encoded))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err != nil || decoder.Decode(&receipt) != nil || receipt.SchemaVersion != 1 || receipt.ProjectID != projectID || receipt.DeploymentID != deploymentID || receipt.PackageID != packageID || receipt.SourceRunID != sourceRunID || receipt.Generation != generation || receipt.RuntimeDigest != runtimeDigest || !secretOutputPackageID.MatchString(receipt.ReceiptID) || len(receipt.Entries) != 2 || receipt.Entries[0] != "admin-token" || receipt.Entries[1] != "unseal-shares" || len(receipt.Digests) != 2 {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	var trailing any
	if decoder.Decode(&trailing) != io.EOF {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	ciphertexts := make(map[string][]byte, 2)
	for _, entry := range []struct{ id, file string }{{"admin-token", "admin-token.age"}, {"unseal-shares", "unseal-shares.age"}} {
		data, _, readErr := directory.readFile([]string{entry.file}, 131072)
		if readErr != nil || !secretOutputDigest.MatchString(receipt.Digests[entry.id]) || ciphertextDigest(data) != receipt.Digests[entry.id] {
			for _, value := range ciphertexts {
				clear(value)
			}
			clear(data)
			return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
		}
		ciphertexts[entry.id] = data
	}
	if syncSecretOutputDirectory(directory) != nil || syncSecretOutputDirectory(deployment) != nil || syncSecretOutputDirectory(root) != nil || syncSecretOutputDirectory(projectRoot) != nil {
		for _, data := range ciphertexts {
			clear(data)
		}
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	return SecretOutputFileReceipt{ReceiptID: receipt.ReceiptID, Directory: filepath.Join(parent, deploymentID, name), Digests: receipt.Digests, ProjectID: projectID, DeploymentID: deploymentID, PackageID: packageID, SourceRunID: sourceRunID, Generation: generation, RuntimeDigest: runtimeDigest}, ciphertexts, nil
}

func ciphertextDigest(data []byte) string {
	digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
}

// ReadSecretOutputReceipt discovers binding only at one canonical deployment
// path supplied by the managed projection, never by directory scanning.
func ReadSecretOutputReceipt(rootPath, projectID, deploymentID, runtimeDigest string) (SecretOutputFileReceipt, map[string][]byte, error) {
	if !secretOutputDeploymentID.MatchString(deploymentID) {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	root, err := openExportSourceDirectory(rootPath)
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer root.close()
	dir, err := root.openDirectory([]string{"secrets", deploymentID})
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputFileReceipt{}, nil, ErrSecretOutputFiles
	}
	defer dir.close()
	data, _, err := dir.readFile([]string{"complete"}, 8192)
	var receipt secretOutputLocalReceipt

	}

//go:build windows

package installer

import (
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

var secretOutputFlush = windows.NewLazySystemDLL("ntdll.dll").NewProc("NtFlushBuffersFileEx")

// Fail closed if the filesystem cannot durably flush the held directory.
func syncSecretOutputDirectory(directory *exportDirectory) error {
	if err := secretOutputFlush.Find(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var status windows.IO_STATUS_BLOCK
	result, _, _ := secretOutputFlush.Call(uintptr(directory.handle), 0, 0, 0, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&status)))
	if int32(result) < 0 {
		return windows.NTStatus(result)
	}
	return nil
}

func openSecretOutputDirectory(parent *exportDirectory, parts []string) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	return parent.openDirectoryWithAccess(parts, windows.FILE_GENERIC_READ|windows.FILE_GENERIC_WRITE|windows.DELETE)
}

package installer

import (
	"sort"

	"platform-installer/internal/coreadapter"
)

const managedInventoryDocument = "inventory/hosts.yml"

type managedServerInventory struct {
	document map[string]any
	hosts    map[string]any
	targets  map[string]any
}

func managedServers(candidates map[string]map[string]any, originals map[string][]byte, root string) (*managedServerInventory, error) {
	document := candidates[managedInventoryDocument]
	if document == nil {
		loaded, content, err := loadOwnedDocument(root, managedInventoryDocument)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		document, candidates[managedInventoryDocument], originals[managedInventoryDocument] = loaded, loaded, content
	}
	all := asMap(document["all"])
	hosts := asMap(all["hosts"])
	children := asMap(all["children"])
	targets := asMap(asMap(children["platform_targets"])["hosts"])
	if all == nil || hosts == nil || children == nil || targets == nil {
		return nil, blocked("WRITE_OWNERSHIP_REQUIRED", "Managed inventory roots are missing or malformed", "inventory/hosts.yml")
	}
	return &managedServerInventory{document: document, hosts: hosts, targets: targets}, nil
}

func serverMap(value any) map[string]any { return asMap(value) }

func portWasSupplied(command EditCommand) bool {
	return command.SSHPort != 0 || command.presentFields["sshPort"]
}

func serverFinalExpectation(inventory *managedServerInventory, hostID string) expectation {
	server := serverMap(inventory.hosts[hostID])
	if server == nil {
		return expectation{Operation: "ServerFinal", First: hostID, Value: map[string]any{"exists": false}}
	}
	platformHost := asMap(server["platform_host"])
	value := map[string]any{"exists": true, "address": server["ansible_host"], "type": platformHost["type"], "desiredHostname": platformHost["desiredHostname"]}
	if port, found := server["ansible_port"]; found {
		value["portPresent"] = true
		value["port"] = port
	}
	return expectation{Operation: "ServerFinal", First: hostID, Value: value}
}

func applyServerCommand(command EditCommand, root string, snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot, candidates map[string]map[string]any, originals map[string][]byte) (expectation, []string, error) {
	inventory, err := managedServers(candidates, originals, root)
	if err != nil {
		return expectation{}, nil, err
	}
	host := serverMap(inventory.hosts[command.HostID])
	switch command.Operation {
	case "CreateServer":
		if host != nil || inventory.targets[command.HostID] != nil {
			return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Server identifier already exists", "command.hostId")
		}
		created := map[string]any{
			"ansible_host":  command.Address,
			"platform_host": map[string]any{"type": command.ServerType, "desiredHostname": command.DesiredHostname},
		}
		if portWasSupplied(command) {
			created["ansible_port"] = command.SSHPort
		}
		inventory.hosts[command.HostID] = created
		inventory.targets[command.HostID] = map[string]any{}
		return serverFinalExpectation(inventory, command.HostID), []string{"SERVER_INVENTORY_CHANGED"}, nil
	case "UpdateServer":
		if host == nil || inventory.targets[command.HostID] == nil {
			return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Server does not exist in managed inventory", "command.hostId")
		}
		platformHost := asMap(host["platform_host"])
		if platformHost == nil {
			platformHost = map[string]any{}
			host["platform_host"] = platformHost
		}
		if command.Address != "" {
			host["ansible_host"] = command.Address
		}
		if command.ServerType != "" {
			platformHost["type"] = command.ServerType
		}
		if command.DesiredHostname != "" {
			platformHost["desiredHostname"] = command.DesiredHostname
		}
		if portWasSupplied(command) {
			host["ansible_port"] = command.SSHPort
		} else if command.ClearSSHPort {
			delete(host, "ansible_port")
		}
		if (command.APIVersion == EditCommandAPIVersionV4 || isEditCommandV5OrLater(command.APIVersion)) && (platformHost["type"] == nil || platformHost["desiredHostname"] == nil) {
			return expectation{}, nil, blocked("SERVER_METADATA_REQUIRED", "Current server edits require type and desired hostname", "command")
		}
		return serverFinalExpectation(inventory, command.HostID), serverUpdateImpacts(command), nil
	case "DeleteServer":
		if host == nil || inventory.targets[command.HostID] == nil {
			return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Server does not exist in managed inventory", "command.hostId")
		}
		delete(inventory.hosts, command.HostID)
		delete(inventory.targets, command.HostID)
		return serverFinalExpectation(inventory, command.HostID), []string{"SERVER_INVENTORY_CHANGED"}, nil
	}
	return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Server operation is unsupported", "command.operation")
}

func serverUpdateImpacts(command EditCommand) []string {
	set := map[string]bool{}
	if command.Address != "" || portWasSupplied(command) || command.ClearSSHPort {
		set["SERVER_INVENTORY_CHANGED"] = true
	}
	if command.ServerType != "" {
		set["SERVER_METADATA_CHANGED"] = true
	}
	if command.DesiredHostname != "" {
		set["SERVER_PREPARATION_CHANGED"] = true
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(set))
	for value := range set {
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	sort.Strings(result)
	return result
}

func serverReferenceInUse(snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot, expectations []expectation) bool {
	if snapshot == nil || snapshot.References == nil || snapshot.References["hosts"] == nil {
		return false
	}
	for _, expected := range expectations {
		if expected.Operation != "ServerFinal" {
			continue
		}
		value := asMap(expected.Value)
		if value != nil && value["exists"] == false && len(snapshot.References["hosts"][expected.First]) > 0 {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

package installer

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"math"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"platform-installer/internal/projectlifecycle"
)

const maxConfigurationValueBytes = 64 * 1024

func catalogConfigurationSetting(catalog *projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogView, serviceType, settingID string) (*projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogSetting, bool) {
	if catalog == nil || catalog.Status != "READY" {
		return nil, false
	}
	for serviceIndex := range catalog.Services {
		service := &catalog.Services[serviceIndex]
		if service.ID != serviceType {
			continue
		}
		for settingIndex := range service.ConfigurationSettings {
			setting := &service.ConfigurationSettings[settingIndex]
			if setting.ID == settingID {
				return setting, true
			}
		}
		return nil, false
	}
	return nil, false
}

func settingAllowsScope(setting *projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogSetting, scope string) bool {
	wanted := "deployment"
	if scope == "MEMBER" {
		wanted = "member"
	}
	for _, candidate := range setting.Scopes {
		if candidate == wanted {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func validateConfigurationValue(setting *projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogSetting, value any) error {
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil || len(encoded) > maxConfigurationValueBytes {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Configuration value is invalid or exceeds its limit", "command.value")
	}
	switch setting.EditorShape {
	case "BOOLEAN":
		if _, ok := value.(bool); !ok {
			return invalidConfigurationValue()
		}
	case "INTEGER":
		integer, ok := configurationInteger(value)
		if !ok || setting.Minimum == nil || setting.Maximum == nil || integer < int64(*setting.Minimum) || integer > int64(*setting.Maximum) {
			return invalidConfigurationValue()
		}
	case "NUMBER":
		number, ok := configurationNumber(value)
		if !ok || setting.Minimum == nil || setting.Maximum == nil || number < *setting.Minimum || number > *setting.Maximum {
			return invalidConfigurationValue()
		}
	case "ENUM":
		for _, allowed := range setting.Enum {
			if configurationEnumEqual(value, allowed) {
				return nil
			}
		}
		return invalidConfigurationValue()
	case "BOUNDED_STRING":
		text, ok := value.(string)
		if !ok || !utf8.ValidString(text) || setting.MinLength == nil || setting.MaxLength == nil {
			return invalidConfigurationValue()
		}
		length := utf8.RuneCountInString(text)
		if length < *setting.MinLength || length > *setting.MaxLength {
			return invalidConfigurationValue()
		}
	case "DNS_DOMAIN":
		text, ok := value.(string)
		if !ok || !utf8.ValidString(text) || !projectlifecycle.ValidDNSDomain(text) {
			return invalidConfigurationValue()
		}
	case "TLS_PROFILE", "SERVICE_DEPLOYMENT":
		text, ok := value.(string)
		if !ok || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(text) {
			return invalidConfigurationValue()
		}
	case "RUNTIME_SECRET_REFERENCE_OBJECT":
		object, ok := value.(map[string]any)
		if !ok || !safeRuntimeSecretReferenceObject(object) || object["passwordSecretRef"] != "runtime:"+setting.RuntimeSecretRequirementRef {
			return invalidConfigurationValue()
		}
		_, usernamePresent := object["username"]
		if setting.RuntimeSecretUsernameRequired != usernamePresent {
			return invalidConfigurationValue()
		}
	default:
		return blocked("SETTING_UNSUPPORTED", "Configuration setting is read-only in this Installer version", "command.setting")
	}
	return nil
}

func invalidConfigurationValue() error {
	return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Configuration value does not match the catalog descriptor", "command.value")
}

func configurationNumber(value any) (float64, bool) {
	switch typed := value.(type) {
	case int:
		if typed > 1<<53 || typed < -(1<<53) {
			return 0, false
		}
		return float64(typed), true
	case int64:
		if typed > 1<<53 || typed < -(1<<53) {
			return 0, false
		}
		return float64(typed), true
	case uint64:
		if typed > 1<<53 {
			return 0, false
		}
		return float64(typed), true
	case float64:
		if math.IsNaN(typed) || math.IsInf(typed, 0) || math.Abs(typed) > 1<<53 {
			return 0, false
		}
		return typed, true
	default:
		return 0, false
	}
}

func configurationInteger(value any) (int64, bool) {
	switch typed := value.(type) {
	case int:
		return int64(typed), true
	case int64:
		return typed, true
	case uint64:
		if typed > math.MaxInt64 {
			return 0, false
		}
		return int64(typed), true
	case float64:
		if math.IsNaN(typed) || math.IsInf(typed, 0) || math.Abs(typed) > 1<<53 || math.Trunc(typed) != typed {
			return 0, false
		}
		return int64(typed), true
	default:
		return 0, false
	}
}

func configurationEnumEqual(value, allowed any) bool {
	switch expected := allowed.(type) {
	case string:
		actual, ok := value.(string)
		return ok && actual == expected
	case bool:
		actual, ok := value.(bool)
		return ok && actual == expected
	case int, int64, uint64:
		expectedInteger, expectedOK := configurationInteger(expected)
		actualInteger, actualOK := configurationInteger(value)
		return expectedOK && actualOK && actualInteger == expectedInteger
	case float64:
		actual, ok := configurationNumber(value)
		return ok && actual == expected
	default:
		return allowed == nil && value == nil
	}
}

func (candidate *structuralCandidate) applyConfigurationCommand(command EditCommand, deployments map[string]any, catalog *projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogView) (bool, error) {
	deployment := asMap(deployments[command.DeploymentID])
	if deployment == nil {
		return false, referenceNotFound("deploymentId")
	}
	serviceType, serviceOK := deployment["serviceType"].(string)
	modeID, modeOK := deployment["mode"].(string)
	if !serviceOK || !modeOK {
		return false, managedReadError("Managed deployment is malformed", desiredDocument)
	}
	if service, mode := catalogServiceMode(catalog, serviceType, modeID); service == nil || mode == nil {
		return false, blocked("CATALOG_VALUE_UNKNOWN", "Deployment service or mode is not declared by the project catalog", "command.deploymentId")
	}
	setting, found := catalogConfigurationSetting(catalog, serviceType, command.Setting)
	if !found {
		return false, blocked("CATALOG_VALUE_UNKNOWN", "Configuration setting is not declared by the project catalog", "command.setting")
	}
	if setting.Kind != "MANAGED" || setting.EditorShape == "UNSUPPORTED" || !settingAllowsScope(setting, command.Scope) {
		return false, blocked("SETTING_UNSUPPORTED", "Configuration setting or scope is read-only in this Installer version", "command.setting")
	}
	if command.Operation == "SetServiceConfigurationValue" {
		if err := validateConfigurationValue(setting, command.Value); err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
	}
	target, logical, err := candidate.configurationTarget(command, deployment)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	configuration := asMap(target["configuration"])
	if configuration == nil && target["configuration"] != nil {
		return false, managedReadError("Managed configuration is malformed", logical)
	}
	if command.Operation == "RemoveServiceConfigurationOverride" {
		if configuration == nil {
			return false, nil
		}
		if _, present := configuration[command.Setting]; !present {
			return false, nil
		}
		delete(configuration, command.Setting)
		if len(configuration) == 0 {
			delete(target, "configuration")
		}
		candidate.dirty[logical] = true
		return true, nil
	}
	if configuration == nil {
		configuration = map[string]any{}
		target["configuration"] = configuration
	}
	value := command.Value
	if setting.EditorShape == "INTEGER" {
		// Wails transports JSON numbers as float64. Persist schema integers as
		// integers, not YAML !!float values rejected by Core's integer schema.
		value, _ = configurationInteger(command.Value)
	}
	if existing, present := configuration[command.Setting]; present && semanticEqual(existing, value) {
		return false, nil
	}
	configuration[command.Setting] = deepCopy(value)
	candidate.dirty[logical] = true
	return true, nil
}

func (candidate *structuralCandidate) configurationTarget(command EditCommand, deployment map[string]any) (map[string]any, string, error) {
	if command.Scope == "DEPLOYMENT" {
		return deployment, desiredDocument, nil
	}
	for logical, document := range candidate.documents {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(logical, "inventory/host_vars/") {
			continue
		}
		placements := asMap(document["platform_deployments"])
		placement := asMap(placements[command.DeploymentID])
		members := asMap(placement["members"])
		member := asMap(members[command.MemberID])
		if member != nil {
			return member, logical, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, "command.memberId", referenceNotFound("memberId")
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/installer/session.go","mode":420,"size":15662,"sha256":"87efe57aab9200e114ed3723efbc715f40896dfb77cbc1577476cb5ee779f3bf","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":15662}
package installer

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

const (
	maxEditSessions    = 8
	maxSessionCommands = 1024
	maxSessionBytes    = 4 * 1024 * 1024
	defaultSessionTTL  = 30 * time.Minute
)

type editSessionState struct {
	public   EditSession
	commands []EditCommand
	updated  time.Time
	busy     bool
}

// EditSessionStore owns transient draft ordering. It persists neither desired
// state nor secrets and serializes review/append/discard for each session.
type EditSessionStore struct {
	mu        sync.Mutex
	now       func() time.Time
	ttl       time.Duration
	sessions  map[string]*editSessionState
	byProject map[string]string
}

func NewEditSessionStore() *EditSessionStore {
	return &EditSessionStore{now: time.Now, ttl: defaultSessionTTL,
		sessions: make(map[string]*editSessionState), byProject: make(map[string]string)}
}

func opaqueID() (string, error) {
	value := make([]byte, 16)
	if _, err := rand.Read(value); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(value), nil
}

func (s *EditSessionStore) expireLocked() {
	now := s.now()
	for id, state := range s.sessions {
		if s.ttl > 0 && now.Sub(state.updated) > s.ttl {
			delete(s.byProject, state.public.ProjectContextID)
			delete(s.sessions, id)
		}
	}
}

// Active reconciles an application-held session identifier with the bounded
// transient store. It intentionally exposes no draft contents.
func (s *EditSessionStore) Active(sessionID string) bool {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.expireLocked()
	_, ok := s.sessions[sessionID]
	return ok
}

func (s *EditSessionStore) Start(projectContextID, projectRoot, classification, revision string) (EditSession, error) {
	if projectContextID == "" || projectRoot == "" || !validSHA256(revision) {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_SESSION", "Project context and revision are required", "session")
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.expireLocked()
	if existing := s.byProject[projectContextID]; existing != "" {
		return s.sessions[existing].public, nil
	}
	if len(s.sessions) >= maxEditSessions {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_LIMIT", "Too many edit sessions are active", "session")
	}
	id, err := opaqueID()
	if err != nil {
		return EditSession{}, err
	}
	now := s.now()
	public := EditSession{APIVersion: EditSessionAPIVersion, Kind: "EditSession", SessionID: id,
		ProjectContextID: projectContextID, ProjectRoot: projectRoot, ProjectClassification: classification,
		BaseProjectRevision: revision, Status: "EDITING", ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.ttl)}
	s.sessions[id] = &editSessionState{public: public, updated: now}
	s.byProject[projectContextID] = id
	return public, nil
}

func validSHA256(value string) bool {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") || len(value) != len("sha256:")+64 {
		return false
	}
	digest := strings.TrimPrefix(value, "sha256:")
	if _, err := hex.DecodeString(digest); err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return digest == strings.ToLower(digest)
}

func (s *EditSessionStore) Append(sessionID string, command EditCommand, backend *Backend) (EditSession, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.expireLocked()
	state := s.sessions[sessionID]
	if state == nil {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_EXPIRED", "Edit session is absent or expired", "sessionId")
	}
	if state.busy {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_BUSY", "Edit session review is in progress", "sessionId")
	}
	command.APIVersion = EditCommandAPIVersionV10
	if applicationEditOperation(command.Operation) {
		command.APIVersion = EditCommandAPIVersionV11
	}
	command.Kind = "EditCommand"
	command.BaseProjectRevision = state.public.BaseProjectRevision
	if backend == nil {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE", "Application configuration is unavailable", "command.type")
	}
	if err := backend.validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return EditSession{}, err
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(command)
	if err != nil {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Edit command cannot be encoded", "command")
	}
	if len(state.commands) >= maxSessionCommands || state.public.EncodedBytes+len(encoded) > maxSessionBytes {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_LIMIT", "Edit session command limit was reached", "command")
	}
	state.commands = append(state.commands, command)
	if state.public.ReviewedPlanID != "" && backend != nil {
		backend.plans.Discard(state.public.ReviewedPlanID)
	}
	state.public.CommandCount = len(state.commands)
	state.public.EncodedBytes += len(encoded)
	state.public.Status = "EDITING"
	state.public.ReviewedPlanID = ""
	state.updated = s.now()
	state.public.ExpiresAt = state.updated.Add(s.ttl)
	return state.public, nil
}

// AmendConfiguration changes only one previously acknowledged configuration
// command. The expected command is a compare-and-swap guard against a stale UI;
// structural commands and other draft targets are never rewritten.
func (s *EditSessionStore) AmendConfiguration(sessionID string, index int, expected EditCommand, replacement *EditCommand, backend *Backend) (EditSession, error) {
	return s.amendCommand(sessionID, index, expected, replacement, backend, false)
}

func (s *EditSessionStore) AmendApplication(sessionID string, index int, expected EditCommand, replacement *EditCommand, backend *Backend) (EditSession, error) {
	return s.amendCommand(sessionID, index, expected, replacement, backend, true)
}

func (s *EditSessionStore) amendCommand(sessionID string, index int, expected EditCommand, replacement *EditCommand, backend *Backend, application bool) (EditSession, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.expireLocked()
	state := s.sessions[sessionID]
	if state == nil {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_EXPIRED", "Edit session is absent or expired", "sessionId")
	}
	if state.busy {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_BUSY", "Edit session review is in progress", "sessionId")
	}
	if backend == nil || index < 0 || index >= len(state.commands) {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("EDIT_COMMAND_CONFLICT", "Configuration draft changed", "command")
	}
	allowed := isConfigurationCommand
	sameTarget := sameConfigurationTarget
	if application {
		allowed = func(c EditCommand) bool { return applicationEditOperation(c.Operation) }
		sameTarget = func(a, b EditCommand) bool {
			return a.DeploymentID == b.DeploymentID && a.EntityID == b.EntityID && a.HostID == b.HostID && a.Property == b.Property && a.Setting == b.Setting && applicationCommandFamily(a.Operation) == applicationCommandFamily(b.Operation)
		}
	}
	normalize := func(command *EditCommand) {
		command.APIVersion = EditCommandAPIVersionV10
		if application {
			command.APIVersion = EditCommandAPIVersionV11
		}
		command.Kind = "EditCommand"
		command.BaseProjectRevision = state.public.BaseProjectRevision
	}
	normalize(&expected)
	prior := state.commands[index]
	if !allowed(prior) || !allowed(expected) {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("EDIT_COMMAND_CONFLICT", "Only configuration draft commands can be amended", "command")
	}
	want, err := json.Marshal(expected)
	if err != nil {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Expected command cannot be encoded", "command")
	}
	old, err := json.Marshal(prior)
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(want, old) {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("EDIT_COMMAND_CONFLICT", "Configuration draft changed", "command")
	}
	if replacement != nil {
		normalize(replacement)
		if !allowed(*replacement) || !sameTarget(prior, *replacement) {
			return EditSession{}, blocked("EDIT_COMMAND_CONFLICT", "Configuration target cannot change", "command")
		}
		if err := backend.validateCommand(*replacement); err != nil {
			return EditSession{}, err
		}
	}
	newBytes := 0
	if replacement != nil {
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(replacement)
		if err != nil {
			return EditSession{}, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Replacement command cannot be encoded", "command")
		}
		newBytes = len(encoded)
	}
	if state.public.EncodedBytes-len(old)+newBytes > maxSessionBytes {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_LIMIT", "Edit session byte limit was reached", "command")
	}
	if replacement == nil {
		state.commands = append(state.commands[:index], state.commands[index+1:]...)
	} else {
		state.commands[index] = *replacement
	}
	if state.public.ReviewedPlanID != "" {
		backend.plans.Discard(state.public.ReviewedPlanID)
	}
	state.public.CommandCount = len(state.commands)
	state.public.EncodedBytes += newBytes - len(old)
	state.public.Status = "EDITING"
	state.public.ReviewedPlanID = ""
	state.updated = s.now()
	state.public.ExpiresAt = state.updated.Add(s.ttl)
	return state.public, nil
}

func isConfigurationCommand(command EditCommand) bool {
	return command.Operation == "SetServiceConfigurationValue" || command.Operation == "RemoveServiceConfigurationOverride"
}

func sameConfigurationTarget(a, b EditCommand) bool {
	return a.DeploymentID == b.DeploymentID && a.Scope == b.Scope && a.MemberID == b.MemberID && a.Setting == b.Setting
}

func (s *EditSessionStore) Review(ctx context.Context, backend *Backend, sessionID string) (*EditPlan, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.expireLocked()
	state := s.sessions[sessionID]
	if state == nil {
		s.mu.Unlock()
		return nil, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_EXPIRED", "Edit session is absent or expired", "sessionId")
	}
	if state.busy {
		s.mu.Unlock()
		return nil, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_BUSY", "Edit session review is already in progress", "sessionId")
	}
	if len(state.commands) == 0 {
		s.mu.Unlock()
		return nil, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_EMPTY", "Edit session contains no commands", "sessionId")
	}
	if state.public.ReviewedPlanID != "" {
		backend.plans.Discard(state.public.ReviewedPlanID)
		state.public.ReviewedPlanID = ""
		state.public.Status = "EDITING"
	}
	state.busy = true
	commands := append([]EditCommand(nil), state.commands...)
	root, classification, revision := state.public.ProjectRoot, state.public.ProjectClassification, state.public.BaseProjectRevision
	s.mu.Unlock()

	plan, err := backend.planCommands(ctx, root, classification, revision, commands)

	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	state = s.sessions[sessionID]
	if state != nil {
		state.busy = false
		state.updated = s.now()
		state.public.ExpiresAt = state.updated.Add(s.ttl)
		if err == nil && plan != nil && plan.CommitAllowed {
			state.public.Status = "REVIEWED"
			state.public.ReviewedPlanID = plan.PlanID
		}
	}
	return plan, err
}

// ReviewStructural builds the local-only Save preview for the current draft.
func (s *EditSessionStore) ReviewStructural(ctx context.Context, backend *Backend, sessionID string) (*StructuralEditPlan, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.expireLocked()
	state := s.sessions[sessionID]
	if state == nil {
		s.mu.Unlock()
		return nil, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_EXPIRED", "Edit session is absent or expired", "sessionId")
	}
	if state.busy {
		s.mu.Unlock()
		return nil, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_BUSY", "Edit session review is already in progress", "sessionId")
	}
	if len(state.commands) == 0 {
		s.mu.Unlock()
		return nil, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_EMPTY", "Edit session contains no commands", "sessionId")
	}
	if state.public.ReviewedPlanID != "" {
		backend.plans.Discard(state.public.ReviewedPlanID)
		state.public.ReviewedPlanID = ""
		state.public.Status = "EDITING"
	}
	state.busy = true
	commands := append([]EditCommand(nil), state.commands...)
	root, classification, revision := state.public.ProjectRoot, state.public.ProjectClassification, state.public.BaseProjectRevision
	s.mu.Unlock()

	plan, err := backend.PlanStructuralSave(ctx, root, classification, revision, commands)

	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	state = s.sessions[sessionID]
	if state != nil {
		state.busy = false
		state.updated = s.now()
		state.public.ExpiresAt = state.updated.Add(s.ttl)
		if err == nil && plan != nil && plan.SaveAllowed {
			state.public.Status = "REVIEWED"
			state.public.ReviewedPlanID = plan.PlanID
		}
	}
	return plan, err
}

func (s *EditSessionStore) BeginCommit(sessionID, planID string) (EditSession, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.expireLocked()
	state := s.sessions[sessionID]
	if state == nil {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_EXPIRED", "Edit session is absent or expired", "sessionId")
	}
	if state.busy || state.public.Status != "REVIEWED" || planID == "" || state.public.ReviewedPlanID != planID {
		return EditSession{}, blocked("EDIT_PLAN_NOT_CURRENT", "Only the latest reviewed plan can be committed", "planId")
	}
	state.busy = true
	state.public.Status = "COMMITTING"
	return state.public, nil
}

// ReviewApplicationPackageImport uses the same session, opaque plan store and
// commit path. Imports cannot be mixed with pending structural edit commands.
func (s *EditSessionStore) ReviewApplicationPackageImport(ctx context.Context, backend *Backend, sessionID, source, kind, name, version, digest string) (*StructuralEditPlan, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.expireLocked()
	state := s.sessions[sessionID]
	if state == nil || backend == nil {
		s.mu.Unlock()
		return nil, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_EXPIRED", "Edit session is absent", "sessionId")
	}
	if state.busy || len(state.commands) != 0 {
		s.mu.Unlock()
		return nil, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_ACTIVE", "Save or discard the current draft before importing", "sessionId")
	}
	if state.public.ReviewedPlanID != "" {
		backend.plans.Discard(state.public.ReviewedPlanID)
		state.public.ReviewedPlanID = ""
		state.public.Status = "EDITING"
	}
	state.busy = true
	root, revision := state.public.ProjectRoot, state.public.BaseProjectRevision
	s.mu.Unlock()
	plan, err := backend.PlanApplicationPackageImport(ctx, root, source, revision, kind, name, version, digest)
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	state = s.sessions[sessionID]
	if state != nil {
		state.busy = false
		state.updated = s.now()
		state.public.ExpiresAt = state.updated.Add(s.ttl)
		if err == nil && plan != nil && plan.SaveAllowed {
			state.public.Status = "REVIEWED"
			state.public.ReviewedPlanID = plan.PlanID
		}
	}
	return plan, err
}

func (s *EditSessionStore) FinishCommit(sessionID, planID string, committed bool) bool {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	state := s.sessions[sessionID]
	if state == nil || !state.busy || state.public.ReviewedPlanID != planID {
		return false
	}
	if committed {
		delete(s.byProject, state.public.ProjectContextID)
		delete(s.sessions, sessionID)
		return true
	}
	state.busy = false
	state.public.Status = "REVIEWED"
	state.updated = s.now()
	state.public.ExpiresAt = state.updated.Add(s.ttl)
	return true
}

func (s *EditSessionStore) Discard(sessionID string, backend *Backend) bool {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	state := s.sessions[sessionID]
	if state == nil || state.busy {
		return false
	}
	if state.public.ReviewedPlanID != "" && backend != nil {
		backend.plans.Discard(state.public.ReviewedPlanID)
	}
	delete(s.byProject, state.public.ProjectContextID)
	delete(s.sessions, sessionID)
	return true
}

func (s *EditSessionStore) ConsumePlan(sessionID, planID string) bool {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	state := s.sessions[sessionID]
	if state == nil || state.public.ReviewedPlanID != planID {
		return false
	}
	delete(s.byProject, state.public.ProjectContextID)
	delete(s.sessions, sessionID)
	return true
}

func applicationCommandFamily(operation string) string {
	switch operation {
	case "SetApplicationLibraryOverride", "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride":
		return "override"
	case "SetApplicationLibrarySlot", "RemoveApplicationLibrarySlot":
		return "slot"
	case "SetApplicationLibraryPlacement", "RemoveApplicationLibraryPlacement":
		return "placement"
	}
	return operation
}

package installer

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"sort"
