  -- account an object owner. Its owner authority is not a revocable DML grant.
  IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_namespace nn WHERE nn.nspname !~ '^pg_' AND nn.nspname <> 'information_schema'
       AND pg_get_userbyid(nn.nspowner) <> owner_name
       AND NOT (nn.nspname='public' AND pg_get_userbyid(nn.nspowner)='pg_database_owner')
       AND coalesce(left(shobj_description(nn.nspowner,'pg_authid'),length(role_prefix)),'')<>role_prefix)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_class cc JOIN pg_namespace nn ON nn.oid=cc.relnamespace
       WHERE nn.nspname !~ '^pg_' AND nn.nspname <> 'information_schema'
       AND cc.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f','S') AND pg_get_userbyid(cc.relowner) <> owner_name
       AND coalesce(left(shobj_description(cc.relowner,'pg_authid'),length(role_prefix)),'')<>role_prefix) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_OBJECT_CONFLICT';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspowner=target_oid AND nspname !~ '^pg_' AND nspname<>'information_schema')
     OR EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_class cc JOIN pg_namespace nn ON nn.oid=cc.relnamespace
       WHERE cc.relowner=target_oid AND nn.nspname !~ '^pg_' AND nn.nspname<>'information_schema'
       AND cc.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f','S')) THEN
    RAISE NOTICE 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_OWNER_AUTHORITY_PRESERVED';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_attribute aa JOIN pg_class cc ON cc.oid=aa.attrelid
      JOIN pg_namespace nn ON nn.oid=cc.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(aa.attacl) x
      WHERE nn.nspname !~ '^pg_' AND nn.nspname<>'information_schema' AND x.grantee IN (0,target_oid)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_COLUMN_GRANTS_CONFLICT';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_namespace nn CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(nn.nspacl) x
      WHERE nn.nspname !~ '^pg_' AND nn.nspname<>'information_schema' AND x.grantee=0 AND x.privilege_type='CREATE')
    OR EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_default_acl d CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(d.defaclacl) x
      WHERE pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole)=ANY(creators) AND x.grantee=0
      AND NOT x.privilege_type=ANY(CASE d.defaclobjtype WHEN 'n' THEN ARRAY['USAGE']
        WHEN 'r' THEN desired WHEN 'S' THEN CASE WHEN 'INSERT'=ANY(desired) THEN ARRAY['USAGE'] ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END
        ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_EXTERNAL_GRANTS_CONFLICT';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_class cc JOIN pg_namespace nn ON nn.oid=cc.relnamespace,
       LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(cc.relacl,acldefault(CASE WHEN cc.relkind='S' THEN 's'::"char" ELSE 'r'::"char" END,cc.relowner))) x
       WHERE nn.nspname !~ '^pg_' AND nn.nspname <> 'information_schema'
       AND cc.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f','S') AND x.grantee=0
       AND NOT x.privilege_type=ANY(CASE WHEN cc.relkind='S' THEN
          CASE WHEN 'INSERT'=ANY(desired) THEN ARRAY['USAGE'] ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END ELSE desired END)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_EXTERNAL_GRANTS_CONFLICT';
  END IF;
{% if application_provider_operation != 'preflight' %}
  -- Reconcile defaults, including removed creator roles and per-schema entries.
  FOR acl IN SELECT d.defaclrole,d.defaclnamespace,d.defaclobjtype,x.privilege_type,x.is_grantable
      FROM pg_default_acl d CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(d.defaclacl) x
      WHERE x.grantee=target_oid AND d.defaclrole<>target_oid LOOP
    expected := CASE acl.defaclobjtype WHEN 'n' THEN schema_rights
      WHEN 'r' THEN desired WHEN 'S' THEN CASE WHEN 'INSERT'=ANY(desired) THEN ARRAY['USAGE'] ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END;
    IF acl.defaclnamespace<>0 OR NOT pg_get_userbyid(acl.defaclrole)=ANY(creators)
       OR NOT acl.privilege_type=ANY(expected) OR acl.is_grantable THEN
      IF pg_get_userbyid(acl.defaclrole)<>owner_name AND
         coalesce(left(shobj_description(acl.defaclrole,'pg_authid'),length(role_prefix)),'')<>role_prefix THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_EXTERNAL_GRANTS_CONFLICT';
      END IF;
{% if application_provider_operation == 'grants' %}
      object_type := CASE acl.defaclobjtype WHEN 'n' THEN 'SCHEMAS' WHEN 'r' THEN 'TABLES' WHEN 'S' THEN 'SEQUENCES' ELSE NULL END;
      IF object_type IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_EXTERNAL_GRANTS_CONFLICT'; END IF;
      EXECUTE format('ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE %I %s REVOKE %s ON %s FROM %I RESTRICT',
        pg_get_userbyid(acl.defaclrole),CASE WHEN acl.defaclnamespace=0 THEN '' ELSE format('IN SCHEMA %I', (SELECT nspname FROM pg_namespace WHERE oid=acl.defaclnamespace)) END,
        acl.privilege_type,object_type,target_name);
      RAISE NOTICE 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CHANGED';
{% else %}
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_REQUIRED';
{% endif %}
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  FOR ns IN SELECT * FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname !~ '^pg_' AND nspname <> 'information_schema' ORDER BY nspname LOOP
    expected := schema_rights;
    SELECT coalesce(array_agg(x.privilege_type),ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO extra
      FROM aclexplode(coalesce(ns.nspacl,acldefault('n',ns.nspowner))) x
      WHERE x.grantee=target_oid AND ns.nspowner<>target_oid AND (NOT x.privilege_type=ANY(expected) OR x.is_grantable);
    IF cardinality(extra)>0 THEN
{% if application_provider_operation == 'grants' %}
      EXECUTE format('REVOKE %s ON SCHEMA %I FROM %I RESTRICT',array_to_string(extra,','),ns.nspname,target_name);
      RAISE NOTICE 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CHANGED';
{% else %}
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_REQUIRED';
{% endif %}
    END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(array_agg(p),ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO missing FROM unnest(expected) p
      WHERE NOT has_schema_privilege(target_oid,ns.oid,p);
    IF cardinality(missing)>0 THEN
{% if application_provider_operation == 'grants' %}
      EXECUTE format('GRANT %s ON SCHEMA %I TO %I',array_to_string(missing,','),ns.nspname,target_name);
      RAISE NOTICE 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CHANGED';
{% else %}
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_REQUIRED';
{% endif %}
    END IF;
    FOREACH object_type IN ARRAY ARRAY['TABLES','SEQUENCES'] LOOP
      expected := CASE WHEN object_type='TABLES' THEN desired ELSE CASE WHEN 'INSERT'=ANY(desired) THEN ARRAY['USAGE'] ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END END;
      SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT x.privilege_type),ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO extra
        FROM pg_class cc CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(cc.relacl,acldefault(CASE WHEN cc.relkind='S' THEN 's'::"char" ELSE 'r'::"char" END,cc.relowner))) x
        WHERE cc.relnamespace=ns.oid AND (CASE WHEN object_type='TABLES' THEN cc.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') ELSE cc.relkind='S' END)
        AND x.grantee=target_oid AND cc.relowner<>target_oid AND (NOT x.privilege_type=ANY(expected) OR x.is_grantable);
      IF cardinality(extra)>0 THEN
{% if application_provider_operation == 'grants' %}
        EXECUTE format('REVOKE %s ON ALL %s IN SCHEMA %I FROM %I RESTRICT',array_to_string(extra,','),object_type,ns.nspname,target_name);
        RAISE NOTICE 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CHANGED';
{% else %}
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_REQUIRED';
{% endif %}
      END IF;
      SELECT coalesce(array_agg(p),ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO missing FROM unnest(expected) p
        WHERE EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_class cc WHERE cc.relnamespace=ns.oid
          AND (CASE WHEN object_type='TABLES' THEN cc.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') ELSE cc.relkind='S' END)
          AND NOT (CASE WHEN object_type='TABLES' THEN has_table_privilege(target_oid,cc.oid,p) ELSE has_sequence_privilege(target_oid,cc.oid,p) END));
      IF cardinality(missing)>0 THEN
{% if application_provider_operation == 'grants' %}
        EXECUTE format('GRANT %s ON ALL %s IN SCHEMA %I TO %I',array_to_string(missing,','),object_type,ns.nspname,target_name);
        RAISE NOTICE 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CHANGED';
{% else %}
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_REQUIRED';
{% endif %}
      END IF;
    END LOOP;
  END LOOP;
  FOREACH object_type IN ARRAY ARRAY['SCHEMAS','TABLES','SEQUENCES'] LOOP
    acl_type := CASE object_type WHEN 'SCHEMAS' THEN 'n' WHEN 'TABLES' THEN 'r' ELSE 'S' END;
    expected := CASE object_type WHEN 'SCHEMAS' THEN schema_rights
      WHEN 'TABLES' THEN desired ELSE CASE WHEN 'INSERT'=ANY(desired) THEN ARRAY['USAGE'] ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END END;
    FOR creator IN SELECT rolname,oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=ANY(creators) LOOP
      SELECT coalesce(array_agg(p),ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO missing FROM unnest(expected) p
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM aclexplode(coalesce((SELECT d.defaclacl FROM pg_default_acl d
          WHERE d.defaclrole=creator.oid AND d.defaclnamespace=0 AND d.defaclobjtype=acl_type),
          acldefault(CASE WHEN acl_type='S' THEN 's'::"char" ELSE acl_type END,creator.oid))) x
          WHERE x.grantee=target_oid AND x.privilege_type=p AND NOT x.is_grantable);
      IF cardinality(missing)>0 THEN
{% if application_provider_operation == 'grants' %}
        EXECUTE format('ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE %I GRANT %s ON %s TO %I',creator.rolname,array_to_string(missing,','),object_type,target_name);
        RAISE NOTICE 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CHANGED';
{% else %}
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_REQUIRED';
{% endif %}
      END IF;
    END LOOP;
  END LOOP;
{% endif %}
END;

      - item != platform_postgresql_data_directory or item | length > 1
      - item != platform_postgresql_config_directory or item | length > 1
      - item != platform_postgresql_log_directory or item | length > 1
    fail_msg: 'BLOCKED: PostgreSQL clean_install path is unsafe or ambiguous'
  loop: "{{ _platform_postgresql_clear_paths }}"

- name: Stop and disable the selected PostgreSQL unit
  ansible.builtin.systemd:
    name: "{{ _platform_postgresql_unit_name }}"
    state: stopped
    enabled: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Wait bounded time for PostgreSQL processes using the selected data path
  ansible.builtin.shell: |
    set -o pipefail
    found=0
    for proc in /proc/[0-9]*; do
      pid="${proc##*/}"
      cmdline="$(tr '\0' ' ' < "${proc}/cmdline" 2>/dev/null || true)"
      case "${cmdline}" in
        /usr/bin/postgres*|postgres*|/usr/bin/pg_autoctl*|pg_autoctl*)
          case "${cmdline}" in
            *"{{ platform_postgresql_data_directory }}"*) found=1 ;;
          esac
          ;;
      esac
    done
    exit "${found}"
  args:
    executable: /bin/bash
  register: platform_postgresql_clear_processes
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false
  retries: "{{ platform_postgresql_clear_stop_retries }}"
  delay: "{{ platform_postgresql_clear_stop_delay }}"
  until: platform_postgresql_clear_processes.rc == 0

- name: Terminate attributable PostgreSQL processes after bounded stop
  ansible.builtin.shell: |
    set -o pipefail
    for proc in /proc/[0-9]*; do
      pid="${proc##*/}"
      cmdline="$(tr '\0' ' ' < "${proc}/cmdline" 2>/dev/null || true)"
      case "${cmdline}" in
        /usr/bin/postgres*|postgres*|/usr/bin/pg_autoctl*|pg_autoctl*)
          case "${cmdline}" in
            *"{{ platform_postgresql_data_directory }}"*) kill -TERM "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true ;;
          esac
          ;;
      esac
    done
  args:
    executable: /bin/bash
  when: platform_postgresql_clear_processes.rc != 0
  changed_when: true

- name: Wait after PostgreSQL process termination
  ansible.builtin.pause:
    seconds: 2
  when: platform_postgresql_clear_processes.rc != 0

- name: Force-stop attributable PostgreSQL processes that ignored termination
  ansible.builtin.shell: |
    set -o pipefail
    for proc in /proc/[0-9]*; do
      pid="${proc##*/}"
      cmdline="$(tr '\0' ' ' < "${proc}/cmdline" 2>/dev/null || true)"
      case "${cmdline}" in
        /usr/bin/postgres*|postgres*|/usr/bin/pg_autoctl*|pg_autoctl*)
          case "${cmdline}" in
            *"{{ platform_postgresql_data_directory }}"*) kill -KILL "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true ;;
          esac
          ;;
      esac
    done
  args:
    executable: /bin/bash
  when: platform_postgresql_clear_processes.rc != 0
  changed_when: true

- name: Verify PostgreSQL processes are absent before deleting runtime files
  ansible.builtin.shell: |
    set -o pipefail
    for proc in /proc/[0-9]*; do
      cmdline="$(tr '\0' ' ' < "${proc}/cmdline" 2>/dev/null || true)"
      case "${cmdline}" in
        /usr/bin/postgres*|postgres*|/usr/bin/pg_autoctl*|pg_autoctl*)
          case "${cmdline}" in
            *"{{ platform_postgresql_data_directory }}"*) exit 1 ;;
          esac
          ;;
      esac
    done
    exit 0
  args:
    executable: /bin/bash
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false
  register: platform_postgresql_clear_final_processes

- name: Reject PostgreSQL processes remaining before clear
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that: platform_postgresql_clear_final_processes.rc == 0
    fail_msg: 'BLOCKED: PostgreSQL process still references the selected data directory'

- name: Inspect PostgreSQL deployment-owned paths before clear

    follow: false
    get_mime: false
    get_attributes: false
    get_checksum: false
  register: platform_postgresql_clear_path_state
  loop: "{{ _platform_postgresql_clear_paths }}"

- name: Reject paths not owned by the PostgreSQL service account
  ansible.builtin.assert:

      - not item.stat.exists or item.stat.gr_name == platform_postgresql_group

  loop: "{{ platform_postgresql_clear_path_state.results }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.item }}"

- name: Remove only selected PostgreSQL deployment state
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ item }}"
    state: absent
  loop: "{{ _platform_postgresql_clear_paths }}"

- name: Remove selected PostgreSQL systemd unit
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ _platform_postgresql_clear_unit }}"
    state: absent

- name: Reload systemd after PostgreSQL deployment cleanup
  ansible.builtin.systemd:
    daemon_reload: true

- name: Clear stale state for the selected PostgreSQL unit
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv: [systemctl, reset-failed, "{{ _platform_postgresql_unit_name }}"]
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Verify PostgreSQL deployment-owned paths are absent
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ item }}"
    get_mime: false
    get_attributes: false
    get_checksum: false
  register: platform_postgresql_clear_final_state
  loop: "{{ _platform_postgresql_clear_paths }}"

- name: Assert PostgreSQL clean_install removed selected runtime paths
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that: not item.stat.exists
    fail_msg: "PostgreSQL clean_install did not remove {{ item.item }}"
  loop: "{{ platform_postgresql_clear_final_state.results }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.item }}"

@@PORTABLE {"path":"services/redis/ansible_collections/platform/redis/plugins/module_utils/application_acl.py","mode":420,"size":11606,"sha256":"a090d8cf65f5e9650aee79c8ab12185f87f34e148ee89a8e89c5b3830251602e","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":11606}
"""Bounded RESP commands and member ownership custody for application ACLs."""
import contextlib
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import socket
import ssl
import stat
import tempfile
import time


class ACLFailure(ValueError):
    pass


class Client:
    def __init__(self, address, port, ca, cert, key, timeout=15):
        context = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=ca)
        if cert:
            context.load_cert_chain(cert, key)
        raw = socket.create_connection((address, port), timeout)
        try:
            self.socket = context.wrap_socket(raw, server_hostname=address)
        except Exception:
            raw.close()
            raise
        self.stream = self.socket.makefile('rb')

    def close(self):
        self.stream.close()
        self.socket.close()

    def read(self):
        line = self.stream.readline(65537)
        if not line.endswith(b'\r\n') or len(line) > 65536:
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_RESPONSE_INVALID')
        kind, value = line[:1], line[1:-2]
        if kind == b'-':
            # Never return the server's error text: commands may contain hashes.
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_COMMAND_FAILED')
        if kind == b'+':
            return value.decode('utf-8')
        if kind == b':':
            return int(value)
        if kind in (b'$', b'*'):
            count = int(value)
            if count == -1:
                return None
            if count < 0 or count > 1048576:
                raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_RESPONSE_INVALID')
            if kind == b'*':
                if count > 4096:
                    raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_RESPONSE_INVALID')
                return [self.read() for _ in range(count)]
            body = self.stream.read(count + 2)
            if len(body) != count + 2 or not body.endswith(b'\r\n'):
                raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_RESPONSE_INVALID')
            return body[:-2].decode('utf-8')
        raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_RESPONSE_INVALID')

    def command(self, *arguments):
        encoded = [str(item).encode('utf-8') for item in arguments]
        payload = b'*%d\r\n' % len(encoded) + b''.join(b'$%d\r\n' % len(item) + item + b'\r\n' for item in encoded)
        self.socket.sendall(payload)
        return self.read()


def private_info(path, directory=False):
    info = os.lstat(path)
    valid_type = stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) if directory else stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
    if not valid_type or info.st_uid != os.getuid() or info.st_mode & 0o077:
        raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_PATH_UNSAFE')
    return info


@contextlib.contextmanager
def member_lock(directory, timeout=15):
    if os.path.realpath(directory) != os.path.abspath(directory):
        raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_PATH_UNSAFE')
    private_info(directory, True)
    path = os.path.join(directory, '.application-accounts.lock')
    descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        info = os.fstat(descriptor)
        if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != os.getuid() or info.st_mode & 0o077 or info.st_nlink != 1:
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_PATH_UNSAFE')
        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
        while True:
            try:
                fcntl.flock(descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
                break
            except BlockingIOError:
                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_LOCK_TIMEOUT')
                time.sleep(0.05)
        yield
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def read_witness(directory):
    path = os.path.join(directory, 'application-accounts.json')
    try:
        descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return {}
    with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        info = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != os.getuid() or info.st_mode & 0o077 or info.st_nlink != 1 or info.st_size > 1048576:
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_PATH_UNSAFE')
        value = json.load(stream)
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or any(not isinstance(key, str) or not isinstance(marker, str) for key, marker in value.items()):
        raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_WITNESS_INVALID')
    return value


def publish_witness(directory, value):
    destination = os.path.join(directory, 'application-accounts.json')
    if os.path.lexists(destination):
        private_info(destination)
    descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.application-accounts-', dir=directory)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
            json.dump(value, stream, sort_keys=True)
            stream.write('\n')
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(temporary, destination)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)


def account_state(client, username):
    value = client.command('ACL', 'GETUSER', username)
    if value is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, list) or len(value) % 2:
        raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_RESPONSE_INVALID')
    return dict(zip(value[::2], value[1::2]))


def command_permissions(rules, commands, categories):
    """Compare ordered ACL rules against the selected server's command metadata."""
    result = set()
    for rule in rules:
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[+-]?(?:@[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*|[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:\|[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)?)', rule):
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_GRANTS_INVALID')
        name = rule[1:] if rule[0] in '+-' else rule
        if name == '@all':
            selected = set(commands) | {'@all'}
        elif name.startswith('@'):
            if name[1:] not in categories:
                raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_GRANTS_INVALID')
            selected = {command for command, groups in commands.items() if name in groups}
        else:
            selected = {command for command in commands if command == name or command.startswith(name + '|')}
            if not selected:
                raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_GRANTS_INVALID')
        if rule.startswith('-'):
            result.difference_update(selected)
        else:
            result.update(selected)
    return result


def ensure_account(client, user_client, directory, username, password, marker, listener, grants, mode, verify=False, timeout=15, preflight=False):
    """One locked check/mutation/save/witness; no password rotation or takeover."""
    changed = False
    with member_lock(directory, timeout):
        acl_path = os.path.join(directory, ('sentinel' if listener == 'sentinel' else 'redis') + '.users.acl')
        private_info(acl_path)
        if listener == 'client' and client.command('CONFIG', 'GET', 'aclfile') != ['aclfile', acl_path]:
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_ACL_FILE_INVALID')
        if listener == 'sentinel':
            config_path = os.path.join(directory, 'sentinel.conf')
            private_info(config_path)
            descriptor = os.open(config_path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                configuration = stream.read(1048577)
            paths = re.findall(r'(?m)^aclfile\s+(.+)$', configuration)
            if len(configuration) > 1048576 or paths not in [[acl_path], ['"' + acl_path + '"']]:
                raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_ACL_FILE_INVALID')
        witness = read_witness(directory)
        witness_key = listener + '/' + username
        actual = account_state(client, username)
        if mode == 'managed' and actual is not None and witness.get(witness_key) != marker:
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_OWNERSHIP_UNKNOWN')
        if actual is None and (verify or mode == 'existing'):
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_ACCOUNT_MISSING')
        if actual is None and witness_key in witness:
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT')
        expected_hash = hashlib.sha256(password.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
        command_tokens = [item if item[0] in '+-' else '+' + item for item in grants['commands']]
        commands, pending = {}, list(client.command('COMMAND'))
        while pending:
            row = pending.pop()
            if not isinstance(row, list) or len(row) < 7:
                raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_METADATA_INVALID')
            children = row[9] if len(row) > 9 else []
            if children:
                pending.extend(children)
            else:
                commands[row[0]] = row[6]
        categories = client.command('ACL', 'CAT')
        expected_commands = command_permissions(command_tokens, commands, categories)
        if actual is None and preflight:
            return False
        tokens = list(command_tokens)
        tokens += ['~' + item for item in grants.get('keys', [])]
        tokens += ['&' + item for item in grants.get('channels', [])]
        if actual is None:
            if client.command('ACL', 'SETUSER', username, 'reset', 'on', '#' + expected_hash, *tokens) != 'OK':
                raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_COMMAND_FAILED')
            changed = True
        else:
            if not {'on'} <= set(actual.get('flags', [])) or set(actual.get('flags', [])) - {'on', 'sanitize-payload'} or actual.get('passwords') != [expected_hash] or actual.get('selectors'):
                raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_ACCOUNT_DRIFT')
            actual_commands = actual.get('commands', '').split()
            observed_commands = command_permissions(actual_commands, commands, categories)
            updates = []
            if observed_commands != expected_commands:
                if verify or mode == 'existing':
                    raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_GRANTS_DRIFT' if observed_commands - expected_commands else
                                     'REDIS_APPLICATION_GRANTS_MISSING')
                updates = ['nocommands', *command_tokens]
            for field, prefix, requested in [('keys', '~', grants.get('keys', [])),
                                              ('channels', '&', grants.get('channels', []))]:
                observed = set(actual.get(field, '').split())
                expected = {prefix + item for item in requested}
                if not observed <= expected:
                    raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_GRANTS_DRIFT')
                missing = sorted(expected - observed)
                if missing:
                    if verify or mode == 'existing':
                        raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_GRANTS_MISSING')
                    updates.extend(missing)
            if updates and not preflight:
                if client.command('ACL', 'SETUSER', username, *updates) != 'OK':
                    raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_COMMAND_FAILED')
                changed = True
        if user_client.command('AUTH', username, password) != 'OK' or (not preflight and 'ping' in grants['commands'] and user_client.command('PING') != 'PONG'):
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_LOGIN_FAILED')
        if changed:
            if client.command('ACL', 'SAVE') != 'OK':
                raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_PERSIST_FAILED')
            witness[witness_key] = marker
            publish_witness(directory, witness)
    return changed

"""Service-owned Redis allocation, shared by infrastructure and app hooks."""
import re


def project_members(instances, deployment, settings):
    result = []
    for slot, source in enumerate(sorted(instances, key=lambda item: item['id'])):
        member = dict(source, slot=slot)
        for name, base in [('redis_port', 'port'), ('sentinel_port', 'sentinel_port')]:
            port = int(settings[base]) + slot
            if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
                raise ValueError('REDIS_LISTENER_PORT_INVALID')
            member[name] = port
        member.update(instance_name=deployment + '-' + source['id'].rsplit('-', 1)[-1],
                      legacy_instance_name=re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]', '_', source['id']))
        for kind in ('data', 'config', 'log'):
            if kind + '_root' in settings:
                member[kind + '_directory'] = settings[kind + '_root'] + '/' + source['id']
        result.append(member)
    return result

#!/usr/bin/python

  - Verify is read-only; default-user credential repair requires explicit overwrite_default.

def checked_lines(content, password, overwrite=False):
    lines = [line.strip() for line in content.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    names, defaults = set(), []
    for line in lines:
        tokens = shlex.split(line)
        if len(tokens) < 3 or tokens[0] != 'user' or tokens[1] in names:
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_ACL_CONTENT_INVALID')
        names.add(tokens[1])
        if any(token.startswith(('>', '<')) or (token.startswith('#') and not re.fullmatch(r'#[a-f0-9]{64}', token)) for token in tokens[2:]):
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_ACL_CONTENT_INVALID')
        if tokens[1] == 'default':
            hashes = [token for token in tokens[2:] if token.startswith('#')]
            flags = set(tokens[2:]) - set(hashes)
            if len(hashes) != 1 or flags - {'on', 'sanitize-payload', '~*', '&*', '+@all'} or not {'on', '~*', '&*', '+@all'} <= flags:
                raise ACLFailure('REDIS_ACL_CONTENT_INVALID')
            if not overwrite and hashes != ['#' + hashlib.sha256(password.encode()).hexdigest()]:
                raise ACLFailure('REDIS_ACL_STATE_MIGRATION_REQUIRED')
            defaults.append(line)
    if len(defaults) != 1:
        raise ACLFailure('REDIS_ACL_CONTENT_INVALID')
    return lines


def read_file(path):
    descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        info = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != os.getuid() or info.st_mode & 0o077 or info.st_nlink != 1 or info.st_size > 1048576:
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_ACL_PATH_UNSAFE')
        return stream.read(1048577)


def comparable(lines):
    result = []
    for line in lines:
        tokens = shlex.split(line)
        if tokens[1] == 'default':
            # Redis adds this default flag on ACL SAVE; it does not change the
            # credential or unrestricted default-user permission policy.
            tokens = tokens[:2] + sorted(token for token in tokens[2:] if token != 'sanitize-payload')
        result.append(tuple(tokens))
    return sorted(result)


def main():
    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec={
        'directory': {'type': 'path', 'required': True}, 'listener': {'choices': ['redis', 'sentinel'], 'required': True},
        'phase': {'choices': ['prepare', 'save', 'verify'], 'required': True},
        'password': {'type': 'str', 'no_log': True, 'required': True}, 'overwrite_default': {'type': 'bool', 'default': False},
        'address': {'type': 'str'}, 'port': {'type': 'int'}, 'timeout': {'type': 'int', 'default': 15}})
    args, client, changed = module.params, None, False
    try:
        directory = args['directory']
        with member_lock(directory, args['timeout']):
            path = os.path.join(directory, args['listener'] + '.users.acl')
            exists = os.path.lexists(path)
            content = ''
            if exists:
                private_info(path)
                content = read_file(path)
                checked_lines(content, args['password'], args['phase'] == 'prepare' and args['overwrite_default'])
            elif args['phase'] != 'prepare':
                raise ACLFailure('REDIS_ACL_FILE_INVALID')
            if args['phase'] == 'prepare':
                if not exists or args['overwrite_default']:
                    default = 'user default on #' + hashlib.sha256(args['password'].encode()).hexdigest() + ' ~* &* +@all'
                    for line in content.splitlines():
                        tokens = shlex.split(line)
                        if tokens and tokens[1] == 'default' and '#' + hashlib.sha256(args['password'].encode()).hexdigest() in tokens:
                            default = line
                    retained = [line for line in content.splitlines() if line.strip() and shlex.split(line)[1] != 'default']
                    proposed = '\n'.join([default] + retained) + '\n'
                    if proposed != content:
                        descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.users-acl-', dir=directory)
                        try:
                            with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                                stream.write(proposed)
                                stream.flush()
                                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                            os.replace(temporary, path)
                        finally:
                            if os.path.exists(temporary):
                                os.unlink(temporary)
                        changed = True
            else:
                client = Client(args['address'], args['port'], directory + '/pki/ca-chain.pem',
                                directory + '/pki/certificate.pem', directory + '/pki/private-key.pem', args['timeout'])
                if client.command('AUTH', 'default', args['password']) != 'OK':
                    raise ACLFailure('REDIS_ACL_LOGIN_FAILED')
                live = client.command('ACL', 'LIST')
                checked_lines('\n'.join(live), args['password'])
                if args['listener'] == 'redis' and client.command('CONFIG', 'GET', 'aclfile') != ['aclfile', path]:
                    raise ACLFailure('REDIS_ACL_CONFIGURATION_INVALID')
                if comparable(checked_lines(content, args['password'])) != comparable(live):
                    if args['phase'] == 'verify':
                        raise ACLFailure('REDIS_ACL_PERSISTENCE_DRIFT')
                    if client.command('ACL', 'SAVE') != 'OK':
                        raise ACLFailure('REDIS_ACL_SAVE_FAILED')
                    private_info(path)
                    saved = checked_lines(read_file(path), args['password'])
                    if comparable(saved) != comparable(live):
                        raise ACLFailure('REDIS_ACL_PERSISTENCE_DRIFT')
                    changed = True
        module.exit_json(changed=changed)
    except ACLFailure as error:
        module.fail_json(msg=str(error))
    except (ValueError, OSError, TypeError, KeyError):
        module.fail_json(msg='REDIS_ACL_OPERATION_FAILED')
    finally:
        if client:
            client.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/python
"""Execute one Redis application account scope over authenticated TLS."""
import re

from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule
from ansible_collections.platform.redis.plugins.module_utils.application_acl import Client, ensure_account, ACLFailure

DOCUMENTATION = r'''
module: application_account
short_description: Ensure or verify one owned application ACL account
description:
  - Uses authenticated TLS, a member lock and a private ownership witness.
  - Credentials are invocation-only module inputs and never process arguments.
options:
  address: {type: str, required: true}

  mode: {type: str, choices: [managed, existing], default: managed}
  verify: {type: bool, default: false}
  preflight: {type: bool, default: false}
  timeout: {type: int, default: 15}
author: Platform Installer

def main():
    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec={
        'address': {'type': 'str', 'required': True}, 'port': {'type': 'int', 'required': True},
        'ca': {'type': 'path', 'required': True}, 'certificate': {'type': 'path'}, 'private_key': {'type': 'path', 'no_log': True},
        'directory': {'type': 'path', 'required': True}, 'admin_password': {'type': 'str', 'required': True, 'no_log': True},
        'username': {'type': 'str', 'required': True}, 'password': {'type': 'str', 'required': True, 'no_log': True},
        'marker': {'type': 'str', 'required': True}, 'listener': {'choices': ['client', 'sentinel'], 'required': True},
        'grants': {'type': 'dict', 'required': True}, 'mode': {'choices': ['managed', 'existing'], 'default': 'managed'},
        'verify': {'type': 'bool', 'default': False}, 'preflight': {'type': 'bool', 'default': False},
        'timeout': {'type': 'int', 'default': 15}}, supports_check_mode=False)
    args, clients = module.params, []
    try:
        username, grants = args['username'], args['grants']
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}', username) or username == 'default' or not 1 <= args['port'] <= 65535 or not 1 <= args['timeout'] <= 120:
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_INPUT_INVALID')
        permitted = {'commands', 'keys', 'channels'}
        if set(grants) - permitted or not isinstance(grants.get('commands'), list) or not grants['commands']:
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_INPUT_INVALID')
        for field, values in grants.items():
            if not isinstance(values, list) or len(values) > 256:
                raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_INPUT_INVALID')
            for value in values:
                if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or len(value) > 256 or any(char.isspace() or ord(char) < 32 for char in value):
                    raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_INPUT_INVALID')
                if field == 'commands' and not re.fullmatch(r'[+-]?(?:@[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*|[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:\|[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)?)', value):
                    raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_INPUT_INVALID')
        for _ in range(2):
            clients.append(Client(args['address'], args['port'], args['ca'], args['certificate'], args['private_key'], args['timeout']))
        if clients[0].command('AUTH', 'default', args['admin_password']) != 'OK':
            raise ACLFailure('REDIS_APPLICATION_ADMIN_LOGIN_FAILED')
        changed = ensure_account(clients[0], clients[1], args['directory'], username, args['password'], args['marker'],
                                 args['listener'], grants, args['mode'], args['verify'], args['timeout'], args['preflight'])
        module.exit_json(changed=changed)
    except ACLFailure as error:
        module.fail_json(msg=str(error))
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
        # Neither RESP errors nor private paths/hash values leave the module.
        module.fail_json(msg='REDIS_APPLICATION_ACCOUNT_FAILED')
    finally:
        for client in clients:
            client.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

@@PORTABLE {"path":"services/vault/ansible_collections/platform/vault/plugins/action/application_credentials.py","mode":420,"size":2232,"sha256":"a7fa1f8dc4b88d99a93fdaf23048dfa19e68e50eec75089fced7e0d24236e509","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":2232}
"""Existing Vault runtime inputs and protected standalone bootstrap custody."""
import os
import re
from ansible.plugins.action import ActionBase
from ansible_collections.platform.core.plugins.module_utils.application_credentials import protected_secret_files


class ActionModule(ActionBase):
    TRANSFERS_FILES = False
    _requires_connection = False

    def run(self, tmp=None, task_vars=None):
        values = task_vars or {}
        try:
            args = self._task.args
            ref = args['provider_id']
            protected_secret_files({}, [], values.get('platform_application_secret_root', ''))
            inputs = [i for i in values.get('platform_runtime_secret_inputs', [])
                      if i.get('purpose') == 'SERVICE_ADMIN_TOKEN' and (i.get('serviceDeployment') == ref or (i.get('serviceDeployment') is None and args.get('single_provider', False)))]
            if inputs:
                if (len(inputs) != 1 or not isinstance(inputs[0].get('value'), str)
                        or not re.fullmatch(r'si-[a-f0-9]{40}', inputs[0].get('requirementRef', ''))
                        or set(inputs[0]) - {'purpose', 'requirementRef', 'value', 'serviceDeployment'}):
                    raise ValueError()
                token = inputs[0]['value']
            else:
                token = values.get('platform_vault_admin_token', '')
                if not token:
                    directory = values.get('platform_vault_bootstrap_output_dir', '')
                    if not directory or not os.path.isabs(directory):
                        raise ValueError()
                    path = os.path.join(directory, 'admin-token')
                    protected_secret_files({'token': path}, ['token'], directory)
                    with open(path, encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                        token = stream.read(4097).strip()
            if not isinstance(token, str):
                raise ValueError()
            if not 1 <= len(token.encode()) <= 4096 or '\n' in token or '\r' in token:
                raise ValueError()
            return dict(changed=False, token=token)
        except Exception:
            return dict(failed=True, msg='APPLICATION_VAULT_ADMIN_CREDENTIAL_INVALID')

from ansible.plugins.action import ActionBase
from ansible_collections.platform.core.plugins.module_utils.application_credentials import protected_secret_files


class ActionModule(ActionBase):
    TRANSFERS_FILES = False

    def run(self, tmp=None, task_vars=None):
        values = task_vars or {}
        args = self._task.args
        try:
            document, provider = args['document'], args['provider']
            mount = provider['mounts'].get(document['mount']+'/', {})
            if mount.get('type') != 'kv' or str(mount.get('options', {}).get('version')) != '2':
                raise ValueError()
            fields = {}
            for field, descriptor in document['fields'].items():
                source = descriptor['source']
                if field == '_platform_owner':
                    raise ValueError()
                if source['kind'] == 'literal':
                    value = source['value']
                elif source['kind'] == 'runtime_secret_ref':
                    protected_secret_files(args['secret_files'], [source['ref']], args['secret_root'])
                    with open(args['secret_files'][source['ref']], encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                        value = stream.read(4097)
                else:
                    raise ValueError()
                if not isinstance(value, str) or not 1 <= len(value.encode()) <= 4096 or '\x00' in value:
                    raise ValueError()
                fields[field] = value
            return dict(changed=False, fields=fields)
        except Exception:
            return dict(failed=True, msg='APPLICATION_VAULT_DOCUMENT_SOURCE_INVALID')

@@PORTABLE {"path":"services/vault/ansible_collections/platform/vault/plugins/filter/application_provider.py","mode":420,"size":3773,"sha256":"28a8c7712201bf239880cb4a77e2c246b67b7cdcf2331f79332eab7117742532","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":3773}
"""Bounded pure reconciliations consumed by builtin uri tasks."""
import ipaddress
from ansible.errors import AnsibleFilterError


def delta(response, fields, owner):
    if response.get('status') == 404:
        if response.get('json', {}).get('data'):
            raise AnsibleFilterError('APPLICATION_VAULT_DOCUMENT_OWNERSHIP_INVALID')
        return dict(method='PUT', body={'options': {'cas': 0}, 'data': dict(fields, _platform_owner=owner)}, changed=True)
    data = response['json']['data']
    if data['data'].get('_platform_owner') != owner or data['metadata'].get('deletion_time') or data['metadata'].get('destroyed'):
        raise AnsibleFilterError('APPLICATION_VAULT_DOCUMENT_OWNERSHIP_INVALID')
    changed = {k: v for k, v in fields.items() if data['data'].get(k) != v}
    return dict(method='PATCH', changed=bool(changed), body={'options': {'cas': data['metadata']['version']}, 'data': changed})


def cidrs(routes, bridges=None):
    try:
        networks = {'127.0.0.1/32'} | {str(ipaddress.IPv4Network(item[0]['prefsrc']+'/24', strict=False)) for item in routes}
        for placement in bridges or []:
            addresses = [address for interface in placement for address in interface['addr_info']
                         if address.get('family') == 'inet' and address.get('scope') == 'global']
            if not addresses:
                raise ValueError('Missing LXC bridge IPv4 subnet')
            for address in addresses:
                network = ipaddress.IPv4Network(address['local']+'/'+str(address['prefixlen']), strict=False)
                if network.prefixlen == 0:
                    raise ValueError('Unrestricted LXC subnet')
                networks.add(str(network))
        return sorted(networks)
    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, IndexError):
        raise AnsibleFilterError('APPLICATION_VAULT_ROUTE_INVALID')


def source_cache(results, provider):
    return {provider+':'+r['item']['mount']+'/'+r['item']['document']: r['fields'] for r in results}


def document_cache(results, values, provider):
    states = {}
    for response in results:
        document = response['item']
        key = provider+':'+document['mount']+'/'+document['document']
        delta(response, values[key], document['owner'])
        states[key] = response
    return states


def role_changed(response, desired):
    if response.get('status') == 404:
        return True
    current = response['json']['data']
    for key, value in desired.items():
        existing = current.get(key)
        if isinstance(value, list):
            if key == 'token_bound_cidrs':
                # Vault serializes a /32 constraint as a bare IPv4 address.
                existing = [str(ipaddress.ip_network(item, strict=False)) for item in existing or []]
                value = [str(ipaddress.ip_network(item, strict=False)) for item in value]
            if sorted(existing or []) != sorted(value):
                return True
        elif existing != value:
            return True
    return False


def verify_fields(results, expected):
    try:
        if len(results) != len(expected):
            return False
        for result in results:
            data = result['json']['data']['data']
            if any(not isinstance(data.get(field), str) or not data[field] for field in expected[result['item']]):
                return False
        return True
    except (KeyError, TypeError):
        return False


class FilterModule:
    def filters(self):
        return {'application_vault_document_cache': document_cache, 'application_vault_verify_fields': verify_fields, 'application_vault_role_changed': role_changed, 'application_vault_source_cache': source_cache, 'application_kv_delta': delta, 'application_vault_cidrs': cidrs}

#!/usr/bin/python
"""Explicit Vault-only Raft clear; never remove the identity-bound member root."""
import ctypes
from contextlib import ExitStack
import json
import os
import pwd
import re
import stat
import subprocess

DOCUMENTATION = r'''

CONFIG_ROOT = '/etc'
UNIT_ROOT = '/etc/systemd/system'
IDENTIFIER = re.compile(r'[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*\Z')


class ClearFailure(Exception):
    """Only fixed safe codes cross the Ansible boundary."""


def require(condition, code):
    if not condition:
        raise ClearFailure(code)


def private_mount_namespace():
    # Prevent external mount propagation after the complete mountinfo check.
    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    libc.unshare.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int]
    libc.unshare.restype = ctypes.c_int
    libc.mount.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p,
                           ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_void_p]
    libc.mount.restype = ctypes.c_int
    require(libc.unshare(0x00020000) == 0, 'VAULT_CLEAR_MOUNT_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE')
    require(libc.mount(None, b'/', None, (1 << 18) | (1 << 14), None) == 0,
            'VAULT_CLEAR_MOUNT_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE')  # MS_PRIVATE | MS_REC


def owned_directory(stack, path, service_uid=None, service_owned_ancestors=False,
                    data_root=None):
    fd = os.open('/', os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    stack.callback(os.close, fd)
    components = path.strip('/').split('/')
    for index, component in enumerate(components):
        require(component not in ('', '.', '..'), 'VAULT_CLEAR_PATH_UNSAFE')
        fd = os.open(component, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                     dir_fd=fd)
        stack.callback(os.close, fd)
        metadata = os.fstat(fd)
        if index == len(components) - 1 and service_uid is not None:
            require(metadata.st_uid == service_uid and
                    stat.S_IMODE(metadata.st_mode) == 0o700,
                    'VAULT_CLEAR_PATH_UNSAFE')
        else:
            allowed_owners = (0, service_uid) if service_owned_ancestors else (0,)
            if (data_root is not None and
                    '/' + '/'.join(components[:index + 1]) == data_root[0]):
                allowed_owners = allowed_owners + (data_root[1],)
            require(metadata.st_uid in allowed_owners and metadata.st_mode & 0o022 == 0,
                    'VAULT_CLEAR_PATH_UNSAFE')
    return fd


def read_owned_file(directory, name, uid, limit, private=False):
    fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=directory)
    try:
        metadata = os.fstat(fd)
        require(stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode) and metadata.st_uid == uid and
                metadata.st_nlink == 1 and metadata.st_size <= limit and
                (stat.S_IMODE(metadata.st_mode) == 0o600 if private
                 else metadata.st_mode & 0o022 == 0), 'VAULT_CLEAR_FILE_UNSAFE')
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'rb', closefd=False) as stream:
            data = stream.read(limit + 1)
        require(len(data) <= limit, 'VAULT_CLEAR_FILE_UNSAFE')
        return data.decode('utf-8')
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def reject_submounts(path):
    with open('/proc/self/mountinfo', 'rb') as stream:
        data = stream.read(8 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)
    require(len(data) <= 8 * 1024 * 1024, 'VAULT_CLEAR_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_INVALID')
    for line in data.decode('utf-8').splitlines():
        fields = line.split()
        require(len(fields) >= 10 and '-' in fields,
                'VAULT_CLEAR_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_INVALID')
        mountpoint = re.sub(r'\\([0-7]{3})', lambda m: chr(int(m[1], 8)), fields[4])
        require(mountpoint != path and not mountpoint.startswith(path + '/'),
                'VAULT_CLEAR_MOUNT_IN_USE')


def unit_properties(unit):
    result = subprocess.run(
        ['/usr/bin/systemctl', 'show', unit + '.service',
         '--property=ActiveState,MainPID,FragmentPath,User,ExecStart'],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=15, check=True)
    require(len(result.stdout) <= 65536, 'VAULT_CLEAR_UNIT_INVALID')
    return dict(line.split('=', 1) for line in result.stdout.decode('utf-8').splitlines()
                if '=' in line)


def require_no_process(config):
    for name in os.listdir('/proc'):
        if not name.isdigit():
            continue
        try:
            with open('/proc/' + name + '/cmdline', 'rb') as stream:
                data = stream.read(65537)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            continue
        args = data.split(b'\0')
        # argv[0] is caller-controlled. Any exact config argument is sufficient
        # to block clear, including a process outside the managed service unit.
        require(len(data) <= 65536 and ('-config=' + config).encode() not in args
                and not any(args[i:i + 2] == [b'-config', config.encode()]
                            for i in range(len(args))), 'VAULT_CLEAR_MEMBER_RUNNING')


def mount_identity(fd):
    with open('/proc/self/fdinfo/' + str(fd), 'rb') as stream:
        info = stream.read(4097)
    require(len(info) <= 4096, 'VAULT_CLEAR_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_INVALID')
    values = [line.split(b':', 1)[1].strip() for line in info.splitlines()
              if line.startswith(b'mnt_id:')]
    require(len(values) == 1 and values[0].isdigit() and len(values[0]) <= 20,
            'VAULT_CLEAR_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_INVALID')
    return int(values[0])


def remove_raft_child(parent, name, member_mount, depth=0):
    """Vault-only fd traversal: no descent into an unchecked mount object."""
    require(depth < 128, 'VAULT_CLEAR_DEPTH_LIMIT')
    metadata = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
    if not stat.S_ISDIR(metadata.st_mode):
        # unlink does not follow symlinks or remove file bind-mount contents.
        os.unlink(name, dir_fd=parent)
        return
    child = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent)
    try:
        opened = os.fstat(child)
        require((metadata.st_dev, metadata.st_ino) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino),
                'VAULT_CLEAR_SOURCE_CHANGED')
        # st_dev cannot distinguish same-filesystem bind mounts. Check the
        # actual opened directory's Linux mount identity before listing it.
        require(mount_identity(child) == member_mount, 'VAULT_CLEAR_MOUNT_IN_USE')
        for entry in sorted(os.listdir(child)):
            remove_raft_child(child, entry, member_mount, depth + 1)
        current = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
        require((current.st_dev, current.st_ino) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino),
                'VAULT_CLEAR_SOURCE_CHANGED')
        os.rmdir(name, dir_fd=parent)
    finally:
        os.close(child)


def same_source(fd, path):
    current = os.stat(path, follow_symlinks=False)
    held = os.fstat(fd)
    require((current.st_dev, current.st_ino) == (held.st_dev, held.st_ino) and
            stat.S_ISDIR(current.st_mode), 'VAULT_CLEAR_SOURCE_CHANGED')


def clear_member(deployment, member, data_directory, confirmation, inspect_only=False, name_prefix='',
                 data_root_directory='', data_root_owner=''):
    require(isinstance(name_prefix, str) and
            (name_prefix == '' or re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,23}', name_prefix) is not None),
            'VAULT_CLEAR_IDENTITY_INVALID')
    service_name = (name_prefix + '-' if name_prefix else '') + 'vault'
    config_root = CONFIG_ROOT + '/' + service_name
    marker_name = '.' + service_name + '-member.json'
    require(all(isinstance(value, str) and len(value) <= 128 and IDENTIFIER.fullmatch(value)
                for value in (deployment, member)), 'VAULT_CLEAR_IDENTITY_INVALID')
    require(confirmation == deployment, 'VAULT_CLEAR_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED')
    require(isinstance(data_directory, str) and 1 < len(data_directory) <= 255 and
            data_directory.startswith('/') and
            all(component not in ('', '.', '..') for component in data_directory[1:].split('/')),
            'VAULT_CLEAR_PATH_UNSAFE')
    require(os.geteuid() == 0, 'VAULT_CLEAR_ROOT_REQUIRED')
    require(all(function in os.supports_dir_fd for function in
                (os.open, os.stat, os.unlink, os.rmdir)) and os.listdir in os.supports_fd,
            'VAULT_CLEAR_SAFE_DELETE_UNAVAILABLE')
    private_mount_namespace()
    uid = pwd.getpwnam(service_name).pw_uid
    require(re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*', deployment) is not None and
            re.fullmatch(r'.+-[1-9][0-9]*', member) is not None,
            'VAULT_CLEAR_IDENTITY_INVALID')
    unit = service_name + '@' + deployment + '-' + member.rsplit('-', 1)[1]
    require(len(unit + '.service') <= 255, 'VAULT_CLEAR_IDENTITY_INVALID')
    data = data_directory
    data_root = None
    if data_root_directory or data_root_owner:
        require(isinstance(data_root_directory, str) and
                data_root_directory.startswith('/') and
                all(component not in ('', '.', '..')
                    for component in data_root_directory[1:].split('/')) and
                data.startswith(data_root_directory + '/') and
                isinstance(data_root_owner, str) and
                re.fullmatch(r'[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]*', data_root_owner) is not None,
                'VAULT_CLEAR_PATH_UNSAFE')
        root_uid = pwd.getpwnam(data_root_owner).pw_uid
        require(data_root_directory != '/var/lib' or root_uid == 0,
                'VAULT_CLEAR_PATH_UNSAFE')
        data_root = (data_root_directory, root_uid)
    config = config_root + '/' + deployment + '/' + member + '/vault.hcl'
    with ExitStack() as stack:
        directory = owned_directory(stack, data, uid, service_owned_ancestors=True,
                                    data_root=data_root)
        marker = json.loads(read_owned_file(directory, marker_name, uid, 4096, private=True))
        require(marker == {'apiVersion': 'platform.installer/vault-member-marker/v1alpha1',
                           'deploymentId': deployment, 'memberId': member, 'instanceName': unit},
                'VAULT_CLEAR_OWNERSHIP_UNKNOWN')
        configs = owned_directory(stack, os.path.dirname(config), uid)
        hcl = read_owned_file(configs, 'vault.hcl', uid, 65536, private=True)
        require(('  path = "' + data + '"') in hcl.splitlines() and
                ('  node_id = "' + unit + '"') in hcl.splitlines(),
                'VAULT_CLEAR_CONFIG_IDENTITY_INVALID')
        units = owned_directory(stack, UNIT_ROOT)
        text = read_owned_file(units, unit + '.service', 0, 65536)
        start = '/usr/bin/vault server -config=' + config
        require(text.splitlines()[0] == '# ' + service_name + '-managed: ' + deployment + '/' + member
                and text.splitlines().count('ExecStart=' + start) == 1 and
                text.splitlines().count('User=' + service_name) == 1, 'VAULT_CLEAR_UNIT_INVALID')
        properties = unit_properties(unit)
        require(properties.get('FragmentPath') == UNIT_ROOT + '/' + unit + '.service' and
                properties.get('User') == service_name and
                ('argv[]=' + start + ' ;') in properties.get('ExecStart', ''),
                'VAULT_CLEAR_UNIT_INVALID')
        reject_submounts(data)
        same_source(directory, data)
        children = sorted(name for name in os.listdir(directory) if name != marker_name)
        if inspect_only:
            return bool(children)
        require(properties.get('ActiveState') in ('inactive', 'failed') and
                properties.get('MainPID') == '0', 'VAULT_CLEAR_MEMBER_RUNNING')
        require_no_process(config)
        member_mount = mount_identity(directory)
        for name in children:
            same_source(directory, data)
            remove_raft_child(directory, name, member_mount)
        same_source(directory, data)
        require(os.listdir(directory) == [marker_name], 'VAULT_CLEAR_INCOMPLETE')
        os.fsync(directory)
        return bool(children)


def main():
    from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule
    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec={
        'deployment_id': {'type': 'str', 'required': True},
        'member_id': {'type': 'str', 'required': True},
        'data_directory': {'type': 'str', 'required': True},
        'confirmation': {'type': 'str', 'required': True},
        'inspect_only': {'type': 'bool', 'default': False},
        'name_prefix': {'type': 'str', 'default': ''},
        'data_root_directory': {'type': 'str', 'default': ''},
        'data_root_owner': {'type': 'str', 'default': ''},
    }, supports_check_mode=True)
    try:
        predicted = clear_member(module.params['deployment_id'], module.params['member_id'],
                                 module.params['data_directory'], module.params['confirmation'],
                                 module.params['inspect_only'] or module.check_mode,
                                 module.params['name_prefix'],
                                 module.params['data_root_directory'],
                                 module.params['data_root_owner'])
        module.exit_json(changed=predicted if module.check_mode or
                         not module.params['inspect_only'] else False)
    except ClearFailure as error:
        module.fail_json(msg=str(error))
    except Exception:
        # No filesystem names, command output, marker/config contents or traceback.
        module.fail_json(msg='VAULT_CLEAR_FAILED')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

  changed_when: false

  delay: 1

@@PORTABLE {"path":"third_party/wails/cmd/wails/build.go","mode":420,"size":7360,"sha256":"33dd6d2316219de8be109f3768dceacc47536639f37401c38807254dafba863a","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":7360}
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/pkg/commands/buildtags"

	"github.com/leaanthony/slicer"
	"github.com/pterm/pterm"
	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/cmd/wails/flags"
	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/cmd/wails/internal/gomod"
	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/internal/colour"
	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/internal/project"
	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/pkg/clilogger"
	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/pkg/commands/build"
)

func buildApplication(f *flags.Build) error {
	if f.NoColour {
		pterm.DisableColor()
		colour.ColourEnabled = false
	}

	quiet := f.Verbosity == flags.Quiet

	// Create logger
	logger := clilogger.New(os.Stdout)
	logger.Mute(quiet)

	if quiet {
		pterm.DisableOutput()
	} else {
		app.PrintBanner()
	}

	err := f.Process()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	projectOptions, err := project.Load(cwd)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// Set obfuscation from project file
	if projectOptions.Obfuscated {
		f.Obfuscated = projectOptions.Obfuscated
	}

	// Set garble args from project file
	if projectOptions.GarbleArgs != "" {
		f.GarbleArgs = projectOptions.GarbleArgs
	}

	projectTags, err := buildtags.Parse(projectOptions.BuildTags)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	userTags := f.GetTags()
	compiledTags := append(projectTags, userTags...)

	// Create BuildOptions
	buildOptions := &build.Options{
		Logger:            logger,
		OutputType:        "desktop",
		OutputFile:        f.OutputFilename,
		CleanBinDirectory: f.Clean,
		Mode:              f.GetBuildMode(),
		Devtools:          f.Debug || f.Devtools,
		Pack:              !f.NoPackage,
		LDFlags:           f.LdFlags,
		Compiler:          f.Compiler,
		SkipModTidy:       f.SkipModTidy,
		Verbosity:         f.Verbosity,
		ForceBuild:        f.ForceBuild,
		IgnoreFrontend:    f.SkipFrontend,
		Compress:          f.Upx,
		CompressFlags:     f.UpxFlags,
		UserTags:          compiledTags,
		WebView2Strategy:  f.GetWebView2Strategy(),
		TrimPath:          f.TrimPath,
		RaceDetector:      f.RaceDetector,
		WindowsConsole:    f.WindowsConsole,
		Obfuscated:        f.Obfuscated,
		GarbleArgs:        f.GarbleArgs,
		SkipBindings:      f.SkipBindings,
		ProjectData:       projectOptions,
		SkipEmbedCreate:   f.SkipEmbedCreate,
		InstallScope:      f.InstallScope,
	}

	tableData := pterm.TableData{
		{"Platform(s)", f.Platform},
		{"Compiler", f.GetCompilerPath()},
		{"Skip Bindings", bool2Str(f.SkipBindings)},
		{"Build Mode", f.GetBuildModeAsString()},
		{"Devtools", bool2Str(buildOptions.Devtools)},
		{"Frontend Directory", projectOptions.GetFrontendDir()},
		{"Obfuscated", bool2Str(f.Obfuscated)},
		{"Install Scope", f.InstallScope},
	}
	if f.Obfuscated {
		tableData = append(tableData, []string{"Garble Args", f.GarbleArgs})
	}
	tableData = append(tableData, pterm.TableData{
		{"Skip Frontend", bool2Str(f.SkipFrontend)},
		{"Compress", bool2Str(f.Upx)},
		{"Package", bool2Str(!f.NoPackage)},
		{"Clean Bin Dir", bool2Str(f.Clean)},
		{"LDFlags", f.LdFlags},
		{"Tags", "[" + strings.Join(compiledTags, ",") + "]"},
		{"Race Detector", bool2Str(f.RaceDetector)},
	}...)
	if len(buildOptions.OutputFile) > 0 && f.GetTargets().Length() == 1 {
		tableData = append(tableData, []string{"Output File", f.OutputFilename})
	}
	pterm.DefaultSection.Println("Build Options")

	err = pterm.DefaultTable.WithData(tableData).Render()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if !f.NoSyncGoMod {
		err = gomod.SyncGoMod(logger, f.UpdateWailsVersionGoMod)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	// Check platform
	validPlatformArch := slicer.String([]string{
		"darwin",
		"darwin/amd64",
		"darwin/arm64",
		"darwin/universal",
		"linux",
		"linux/amd64",
		"linux/arm64",
		"linux/arm",
		"windows",
		"windows/amd64",
		"windows/arm64",
		"windows/386",
	})

	outputBinaries := map[string]string{}

	// Allows cancelling the build after the first error. It would be nice if targets.Each would support funcs
	// returning an error.
	var targetErr error
	targets := f.GetTargets()
	targets.Each(func(platform string) {
		if targetErr != nil {
			return
		}

		if !validPlatformArch.Contains(platform) {
			buildOptions.Logger.Println("platform '%s' is not supported - skipping. Supported platforms: %s", platform, validPlatformArch.Join(","))
			return
		}

		desiredFilename := projectOptions.OutputFilename
		if desiredFilename == "" {
			desiredFilename = projectOptions.Name
		}
		desiredFilename = strings.TrimSuffix(desiredFilename, ".exe")

		// Calculate platform and arch
		platformSplit := strings.Split(platform, "/")
		buildOptions.Platform = platformSplit[0]
		buildOptions.Arch = f.GetDefaultArch()
		if len(platformSplit) > 1 {
			buildOptions.Arch = platformSplit[1]
		}
		banner := "Building target: " + buildOptions.Platform + "/" + buildOptions.Arch
		pterm.DefaultSection.Println(banner)

		if f.Upx && platform == "darwin/universal" {
			pterm.Warning.Println("Warning: compress flag unsupported for universal binaries. Ignoring.")
			f.Upx = false
		}

		switch buildOptions.Platform {
		case "linux":
			if runtime.GOOS != "linux" {
				pterm.Warning.Println("Crosscompiling to Linux not currently supported.")
				return
			}
		case "darwin":
			if runtime.GOOS != "darwin" {
				pterm.Warning.Println("Crosscompiling to Mac not currently supported.")
				return
			}
			macTargets := targets.Filter(func(platform string) bool {
				return strings.HasPrefix(platform, "darwin")
			})
			if macTargets.Length() == 2 {
				buildOptions.BundleName = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s.app", desiredFilename, buildOptions.Arch)
			}
		}

		if targets.Length() > 1 {
			// target filename
			switch buildOptions.Platform {
			case "windows":
				desiredFilename = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", desiredFilename, buildOptions.Arch)
			case "linux", "darwin":
				desiredFilename = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-%s", desiredFilename, buildOptions.Platform, buildOptions.Arch)
			}
		}
		if buildOptions.Platform == "windows" {
			desiredFilename += ".exe"
		}
		buildOptions.OutputFile = desiredFilename

		if f.OutputFilename != "" {
			buildOptions.OutputFile = f.OutputFilename
		}

		if f.Obfuscated && f.SkipBindings {
			pterm.Warning.Println("obfuscated flag overrides skipbindings flag.")
			buildOptions.SkipBindings = false
		}

		if !f.DryRun {
			// Start Time
			start := time.Now()

			compiledBinary, err := build.Build(buildOptions)
			if err != nil {
				pterm.Error.Println(err.Error())
				targetErr = err
				return
			}

			buildOptions.IgnoreFrontend = true
			buildOptions.CleanBinDirectory = false

			// Output stats
			buildOptions.Logger.Println("%s", fmt.Sprintf("Built '%s' in %s.\n", compiledBinary, time.Since(start).Round(time.Millisecond).String()))

			outputBinaries[buildOptions.Platform+"/"+buildOptions.Arch] = compiledBinary
		} else {
			pterm.Info.Println("Dry run: skipped build.")
		}
	})

	if targetErr != nil {
		return targetErr
	}

	if f.DryRun {
		return nil
	}

	if f.NSIS {
		amd64Binary := outputBinaries["windows/amd64"]
		arm64Binary := outputBinaries["windows/arm64"]
		if amd64Binary == "" && arm64Binary == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("cannot build nsis installer - no windows targets")
		}

		if err := build.GenerateNSISInstaller(buildOptions, amd64Binary, arm64Binary); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	return nil
}

package main

import (
	"os"

	"github.com/pterm/pterm"
	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/cmd/wails/flags"

	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/internal/colour"

)

func devApplication(f *flags.Dev) error {
	if f.NoColour {
		pterm.DisableColor()
		colour.ColourEnabled = false
	}

	quiet := f.Verbosity == flags.Quiet

	// Create logger
	logger := clilogger.New(os.Stdout)
	logger.Mute(quiet)

	if quiet {
		pterm.DisableOutput()
	} else {
		app.PrintBanner()
	}

	err := f.Process()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return dev.Application(f, logger)
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"third_party/wails/cmd/wails/doctor.go","mode":420,"size":7554,"sha256":"fb05bf0e6ab624b6af007c01f4552ef893a19a596be99dc1d94fd7530d89f1bf","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":7554}
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
	"runtime/debug"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/internal/shell"

	"github.com/pterm/pterm"

	"github.com/jaypipes/ghw"
	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/cmd/wails/flags"
	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/internal/colour"
	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/internal/system"
	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/internal/system/packagemanager"
)

func diagnoseEnvironment(f *flags.Doctor) error {
	if f.NoColour {
		pterm.DisableColor()
		colour.ColourEnabled = false
	}

	pterm.DefaultSection = *pterm.DefaultSection.
		WithBottomPadding(0).
		WithStyle(pterm.NewStyle(pterm.FgBlue, pterm.Bold))

	pterm.Println() // Spacer
	pterm.DefaultHeader.WithBackgroundStyle(pterm.NewStyle(pterm.BgLightBlue)).WithMargin(10).Println("Wails Doctor")
	pterm.Println() // Spacer

	spinner, _ := pterm.DefaultSpinner.WithRemoveWhenDone().Start("Scanning system - Please wait (this may take a long time)...")

	// Get system info
	info, err := system.GetInfo()
	if err != nil {
		spinner.Fail()
		pterm.Error.Println("Failed to get system information")
		return err
	}
	spinner.Success()

	pterm.DefaultSection.Println("Wails")

	wailsTableData := pterm.TableData{
		{"Version", app.Version()},
	}

	if buildInfo, _ := debug.ReadBuildInfo(); buildInfo != nil {
		buildSettingToName := map[string]string{
			"vcs.revision": "Revision",
			"vcs.modified": "Modified",
		}
		for _, buildSetting := range buildInfo.Settings {
			name := buildSettingToName[buildSetting.Key]
			if name == "" {
				continue
			}
			wailsTableData = append(wailsTableData, []string{name, buildSetting.Value})
		}
	}

	// Exit early if PM not found
	if info.PM != nil {
		wailsTableData = append(wailsTableData, []string{"Package Manager", info.PM.Name()})
	}

	err = pterm.DefaultTable.WithBoxed().WithData(wailsTableData).Render()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	pterm.DefaultSection.Println("System")

	systemTabledata := pterm.TableData{
		{pterm.Bold.Sprint("OS"), info.OS.Name},
		{pterm.Bold.Sprint("Version"), info.OS.Version},
		{pterm.Bold.Sprint("ID"), info.OS.ID},
		{pterm.Bold.Sprint("Branding"), info.OS.Branding},
		{pterm.Bold.Sprint("Go Version"), runtime.Version()},
		{pterm.Bold.Sprint("Platform"), runtime.GOOS},
		{pterm.Bold.Sprint("Architecture"), runtime.GOARCH},
	}

	// Probe CPU
	cpus, _ := ghw.CPU()
	if cpus != nil {
		prefix := "CPU"
		for idx, cpu := range cpus.Processors {
			if len(cpus.Processors) > 1 {
				prefix = "CPU " + strconv.Itoa(idx+1)
			}
			systemTabledata = append(systemTabledata, []string{prefix, cpu.Model})
		}
	} else {
		cpuInfo := "Unknown"
		if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
			// Try to get CPU info from sysctl
			if stdout, _, err := shell.RunCommand("", "sysctl", "-n", "machdep.cpu.brand_string"); err == nil {
				cpuInfo = strings.TrimSpace(stdout)
			}
		}
		systemTabledata = append(systemTabledata, []string{"CPU", cpuInfo})
	}

	// Probe GPU
	gpu, _ := ghw.GPU(ghw.WithDisableWarnings())
	if gpu != nil {
		prefix := "GPU"
		for idx, card := range gpu.GraphicsCards {
			if len(gpu.GraphicsCards) > 1 {
				prefix = "GPU " + strconv.Itoa(idx+1) + " "
			}
			if card.DeviceInfo == nil {
				systemTabledata = append(systemTabledata, []string{prefix, "Unknown"})
				continue
			}
			details := fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) - Driver: %s", card.DeviceInfo.Product.Name, card.DeviceInfo.Vendor.Name, card.DeviceInfo.Driver)
			systemTabledata = append(systemTabledata, []string{prefix, details})
		}
	} else {
		gpuInfo := "Unknown"
		if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
			// Try to get GPU info from system_profiler
			if stdout, _, err := shell.RunCommand("", "system_profiler", "SPDisplaysDataType"); err == nil {
				var (
					startCapturing bool
					gpuInfoDetails []string
				)
				for _, line := range strings.Split(stdout, "\n") {
					if strings.Contains(line, "Chipset Model") {
						startCapturing = true
					}
					if startCapturing {
						gpuInfoDetails = append(gpuInfoDetails, strings.TrimSpace(line))
					}
					if strings.Contains(line, "Metal Support") {
						break
					}
				}
				if len(gpuInfoDetails) > 0 {
					gpuInfo = strings.Join(gpuInfoDetails, " ")
				}
			}
		}
		systemTabledata = append(systemTabledata, []string{"GPU", gpuInfo})
	}

	memory, _ := ghw.Memory()
	if memory != nil {
		systemTabledata = append(systemTabledata, []string{"Memory", strconv.Itoa(int(memory.TotalPhysicalBytes/1024/1024/1024)) + "GB"})
	} else {
		memInfo := "Unknown"
		if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
			// Try to get Memory info from sysctl
			if stdout, _, err := shell.RunCommand("", "sysctl", "-n", "hw.memsize"); err == nil {
				if memSize, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(stdout)); err == nil {
					memInfo = strconv.Itoa(memSize/1024/1024/1024) + "GB"
				}
			}
		}
		systemTabledata = append(systemTabledata, []string{"Memory", memInfo})
	}

	err = pterm.DefaultTable.WithBoxed().WithData(systemTabledata).Render()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	pterm.DefaultSection.Println("Dependencies")

	// Output Dependencies Status
	var dependenciesMissing []string
	var externalPackages []*packagemanager.Dependency
	dependenciesAvailableRequired := 0
	dependenciesAvailableOptional := 0

	dependenciesTableData := pterm.TableData{
		{"Dependency", "Package Name", "Status", "Version"},
	}

	hasOptionalDependencies := false
	// Loop over dependencies
	for _, dependency := range info.Dependencies {
		name := dependency.Name

		if dependency.Optional {
			name = pterm.Gray("*") + name
			hasOptionalDependencies = true
		}

		packageName := "Unknown"
		status := pterm.LightRed("Not Found")

		// If we found the package
		if dependency.PackageName != "" {
			packageName = dependency.PackageName

			// If it's installed, update the status
			if dependency.Installed {
				status = pterm.LightGreen("Installed")
			} else {
				// Generate meaningful status text
				status = pterm.LightMagenta("Available")

				if dependency.Optional {
					dependenciesAvailableOptional++
				} else {
					dependenciesAvailableRequired++
				}
			}
		} else {
			if !dependency.Optional {
				dependenciesMissing = append(dependenciesMissing, dependency.Name)
			}

			if dependency.External {
				externalPackages = append(externalPackages, dependency)
			}
		}

		dependenciesTableData = append(dependenciesTableData, []string{name, packageName, status, dependency.Version})
	}

	dependenciesTableString, _ := pterm.DefaultTable.WithHasHeader(true).WithData(dependenciesTableData).Srender()
	dependenciesBox := pterm.DefaultBox.WithTitleBottomCenter()

	if hasOptionalDependencies {
		dependenciesBox = dependenciesBox.WithTitle(pterm.Gray("*") + " - Optional Dependency")
	}

	dependenciesBox.Println(dependenciesTableString)

	pterm.DefaultSection.Println("Diagnosis")

	// Generate an appropriate diagnosis

	if dependenciesAvailableRequired != 0 {
		pterm.Println("Required package(s) installation details: \n" + info.Dependencies.InstallAllRequiredCommand())
	}

	if dependenciesAvailableOptional != 0 {
		pterm.Println("Optional package(s) installation details: \n" + info.Dependencies.InstallAllOptionalCommand())
	}

	if len(dependenciesMissing) == 0 && dependenciesAvailableRequired == 0 {
		pterm.Success.Println("Your system is ready for Wails development!")
	} else {
		pterm.Warning.Println("Your system has missing dependencies!")
	}

	if len(dependenciesMissing) != 0 {
		pterm.Println("Fatal:")
		pterm.Println("Required dependencies missing: " + strings.Join(dependenciesMissing, " "))
	}

	pterm.Println() // Spacer for sponsor message
	return nil
}

type Build struct {

func (b *Build) Default() *Build {
	defaultPlatform := os.Getenv("GOOS")
	if defaultPlatform == "" {
		defaultPlatform = runtime.GOOS
	}
	defaultArch := os.Getenv("GOARCH")
	if defaultArch == "" {
		if system.IsAppleSilicon {
			defaultArch = "arm64"
		} else {
			defaultArch = runtime.GOARCH
		}
	}

	result := &Build{
		Platform:     defaultPlatform + "/" + defaultArch,
		WebView2:     "download",
		GarbleArgs:   "-literals -tiny -seed=random",
		InstallScope: "machine",
		defaultArch:  defaultArch,
	}
	result.BuildCommon = result.BuildCommon.Default()
	return result
}

func (b *Build) GetBuildMode() build.Mode {
	if b.Debug {
		return build.Debug
	}
	return build.Production
}

func (b *Build) GetWebView2Strategy() string {
	return b.wv2rtstrategy
}

func (b *Build) GetTargets() *slicer.StringSlicer {
	var targets slicer.StringSlicer
	targets.AddSlice(strings.Split(b.Platform, ","))
	targets.Deduplicate()
	return &targets
}

func (b *Build) GetCompilerPath() string {
	return b.compilerPath
}

func (b *Build) GetTags() []string {
	return b.userTags
}

func (b *Build) Process() error {
	// Lookup compiler path
	var err error
	b.compilerPath, err = exec.LookPath(b.Compiler)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("unable to find compiler: %s", b.Compiler)
	}

	// Process User Tags
	b.userTags, err = buildtags.Parse(b.Tags)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// WebView2 installer strategy (download by default)
	b.WebView2 = strings.ToLower(b.WebView2)
	if b.WebView2 != "" {
		validWV2Runtime := slicer.String([]string{"download", "embed", "browser", "error"})
		if !validWV2Runtime.Contains(b.WebView2) {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid option for flag 'webview2': %s", b.WebView2)
		}
		b.wv2rtstrategy = "wv2runtime." + b.WebView2
	}

	// Validate install scope
	b.InstallScope = strings.ToLower(b.InstallScope)
	if b.InstallScope != "" {
		validScopes := slicer.String([]string{"machine", "user"})
		if !validScopes.Contains(b.InstallScope) {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid option for flag 'installscope': %s", b.InstallScope)
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func bool2Str(b bool) string {
	if b {
		return "true"
	}
	return "false"
}

func (b *Build) GetBuildModeAsString() string {
	if b.Debug {
		return "debug"
	}
	return "production"
}

func (b *Build) GetDefaultArch() string {
	return b.defaultArch
}

func (*Dev) Default() *Dev {
	result := &Dev{
		Extensions: "go",
		Debounce:   100,
		LogLevel:   "Info",
	}
	result.BuildCommon = result.BuildCommon.Default()
	return result
